plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-local-model-supervisor

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) | **English**

> **Lazy-start a local llama.cpp model when DSH needs it, release RAM/VRAM when it doesn't.**
>
> **本地大模型「用到才起、不用就放」:按需冷启动 + 空闲自动释放 + 一个假的上下文上限来兜住压缩。**

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **AI-written code.** Every file in this repository was produced by an AI coding agent, not by
> hand — see **[AI-DISCLOSURE.md](AI-DISCLOSURE.md)** before you run it. It was verified on a
> single Windows machine, with no security review and no test suite.
>
> **本项目由 AI 编写。** 全部代码与文档均由 AI 编码助手产出,不是手写的 —— 运行前请先读
> **[AI-DISCLOSURE.md](AI-DISCLOSURE.md)**。仅在作者的一台 Windows 机器上验证过,无安全审计、无测试套件。

A local-model supervisor for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai). It occupies the
ports your DSH local routes already point at and runs `llama-server` on private internal ports:
the model is loaded on the first request and **all RAM/VRAM is given back once it goes idle**.
Ships with a DSH plugin so the whole thing starts and stops with DSH.

```
DSH ──> 127.0.0.1:8080 (supervisor, always resident: ~30 MB RAM, 0 VRAM)
              │
              ├─ first inference request ──> 127.0.0.1:9080 (llama-server, started on demand)
              └─ 500s with no requests   ──> llama-server killed, VRAM released
```

---

## 1. Why this exists

DSH's local routes go through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`, whose config is just
`api: openai-completions` + `baseURL` — it is a plain **HTTP client**. It has no hook that could
execute `llama-server.exe`. So in practice: the model is statically configured and always visible
in the model picker, but selecting it while nothing is running just fails to connect, and
**nothing will ever start it for you**.

The decision to lazy-start has to happen *before* the request reaches llama-server, so it can only
be intercepted at the HTTP layer. This project makes the supervisor **occupy the ports DSH is
already talking to** and moves the real llama-server to internal ports — so **no DSH configuration
has to change at all**, and curl / Python / any other client gets the same behaviour for free.

## 2. Features

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| **Only inference routes wake a model** | A stray request to the port must not load a multi-GB model — and, with a single GPU slot, must not kill whatever is serving. Non-inference paths get a plain 404 (with the caller's User-Agent logged) while nothing is loaded. Added after a client polling `GET /wyvrn/Synapse` swapped the resident model 24 times and cut off live generations. |
| **Never kills a live generation** | Switching models checks whether the resident model still has active requests; if it is mid-stream the switch is refused with a 503 explaining why, instead of cutting the stream off. |
| **Cheap while idle** | The resident supervisor is one Node process and measures ~2–4 MB above a bare `node.exe` on the same machine (bare node 36.9 MB, supervisor ~38–41 MB RSS; JS heap ~6 MB). It holds **no VRAM at all** until a request arrives. `node supervisor.js` also reports its own breakdown at `GET /__supervisor/status` → `memory`. |
| **One unified model list** | Declare any number of local models in a single list. Give a **`path`** and the supervisor manages the process; give a **`url`** and it just forwards to a server you already run (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, …). Two fields per entry is enough. |
| **Ports allocated automatically** | The *i*-th model takes `publicBase + i`; managed models take the next free port at or above `internalBase`, skipping anything claimed. Collisions are rejected at startup, never at spawn time. |
| **Routes generated for you** | `scripts/export-dsh-routes.ps1` turns the list into a ready-to-paste DSH `providers:` block, so importing a model does not mean hand-writing YAML. |
| **Cold start on demand** | The first inference request spawns llama-server, waits for health, then proxies. Clients never need to retry. |
| **Idle release** | After `idleTimeoutSec` (default 500s) with no requests the process is killed and **both RAM and VRAM are returned**. The countdown starts when the last request *ends*, so long generations are never cut off. |
| **Metadata never wakes the GPU** | `/health` and `/v1/models` are answered synthetically; `/props` and `/metrics` return 503 while unloaded. **Otherwise a client polling `/v1/models` would pin the VRAM forever.** |
| **Single GPU slot** | Requesting a different model stops the current one first (one card cannot hold two). |
| **Soft context ceiling ("fake overflow")** | A fake ceiling below the real window forces DSH to compact while redundancy still exists — see section 5. |
| **Compaction grace window** | After a rejection, requests are let through for a while, so the summarization replay cannot be blocked by the same ceiling. |
| **Cold-start protection** | A 1-token warm-up plus a settle delay, and one automatic restart-and-replay if the server still dies on its first large request. |
| **Streaming preserved** | Byte-for-byte `pipe` forwarding; SSE works untouched. |
| **DSH plugin** | Starts/stops with DSH, plus `/localmodel status \| unload \| start` from any chat. |

## 3. Quick start

### 3.1 Requirements

- **Node.js ≥ 18** (standard library only — no third-party dependencies)
- **llama.cpp**'s `llama-server` (CUDA / Vulkan / CPU all work; developed against a Windows CUDA build)
- **PowerShell 7+** (optional, only for the `.ps1` helper scripts; the supervisor itself is pure Node)

### 3.2 Configure

```bash
cp supervisor/models.example.json supervisor/models.json
```

`models` is **one unified list** that accepts both kinds of local model source. All an entry needs
is a `name` plus either `path` or `url`:

```jsonc
{
  "idleTimeoutSec": 500,                       // how long before a model is released
  "ports": { "publicBase": 8080, "internalBase": 9080 },

  "defaults": {                                // applied to every managed model
    "ctxSize": 32768,
    "cacheTypeK": "q8_0",
    "cacheTypeV": "q4_0",
    "softContextRatio": 0.75                   // softContextLimit = ctxSize * this
  },

  "llamaServer": {
    "bin": "C:\\path\\to\\llama-server.exe",
    "args": [ "--host", "127.0.0.1", "--threads", "8", "--flash-attn", "on", "--jinja", ... ]
  },

  "models": [
    { "name": "qwen-2bit", "path": "D:\\models\\Qwen-2bit.gguf" },
    { "name": "qwen-4bit", "path": "D:\\models\\Qwen-4bit.gguf", "ctxSize": 16384, "mtp": true },
    { "name": "ollama",    "url":  "http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1" },
    { "name": "lmstudio",  "url":  "http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1" }
  ]
}
```

| Entry | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| **`path`** — managed | The supervisor spawns llama-server for that file, cold-starts it on the first request and releases RAM/VRAM when idle. |
| **`url`** — external | An already-running OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, another llama.cpp). The supervisor only **forwards** to it on its own public port; it is never started or stopped, so external entries get no idle release. |

**Ports are handed out for you.** The *i*-th entry takes `publicBase + i`, and each managed entry
takes the next free port at or above `internalBase` — skipping anything already claimed, so even a
deliberately overlapping base pair (8080 / 8081) can never hand the same port to two things.
Set `publicPort` / `internalPort` on an entry to override; genuine duplicates are rejected at
startup with a clear error instead of failing later at spawn time.

**Backwards compatible.** `common` is still accepted as an alias for `llamaServer`, and the legacy
explicit schema (`publicPort` / `internalPort` / `model` / `args` per entry) keeps working unchanged.

### 3.3 Generate the DSH routes

Declaring a model is only half the job — DSH also needs a route pointing at it, and hand-writing
YAML for every model does not scale. Generate it from the same config instead:

```powershell
pwsh -File scripts/export-dsh-routes.ps1                          # print to stdout
pwsh -File scripts/export-dsh-routes.ps1 -OutFile ..\routes.yml   # or write it to a file
```

It emits a ready-to-paste `providers:` block — one route per model, pointing at that model's
supervisor public port, with `contextW

plugins.description: Per-model reasoning effort levels inside DeepSeek Harness Settings -> Models, written to that model's reasoningEfforts in cordis.patch.yml.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-reasoning-levels

Per-model reasoning effort levels inside DeepSeek Harness's **Settings → Models**.
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/releases/tag/v0.1.2)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.17-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

**Model Reasoning Levels** — the reasoning-effort control each model entry is
missing, written straight into that model's `reasoningEfforts` in the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`.

The shipped Models page edits a model's `id`, display name, context window,
max-output tokens and input types, and deliberately edits **no** reasoning
effort: effort is a per-*model* capability while that editor is per-*provider*.
This plugin adds the missing control **inside each model entry** — directly
under the id/name line, or under the expanded context-window/input-types area —
and converts the selection into the model's `reasoningEfforts` in the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`.

## What it contributes

| Surface | What it does |
|---|---|
| `settings.models.provider-card` (keyed `llm-pi-ai`) | reaches each pi-ai provider card, discovers its model rows, and portals a per-model effort editor into every model entry — hand-declared routes included |
| Locale namespace `dsh-model-reasoning-levels` | English and Simplified Chinese copy |
| `scripts/reasoning-efforts.mjs` | validates a selection and prints the `reasoningEfforts` YAML and the settings path op it becomes |

Browser half only: the host half (`exports["."]`) exists so the Loader row can
carry the browser half (`exports["./client"]`). No route, no service, no Config.

## What it looks like

```
Settings → Models → Baidu Team → Customized settings → Models
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ [deepseek-v4.1-flash] [DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash]       ⌄   🗑   │
│ Reasoning effort levels              Inherited              │
│ [Off] [Minimal] [Low] [Medium] [High] [XHigh] [Max]        │
│ Low wire value: low   High wire value: high                 │
│ [Inherit catalog] [Non-reasoning] [Apply]  { off: null, … } │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

![The Reasoning effort levels control appended inside a model entry on the Settings → Models page](docs/images/reasoning-levels-row.png)

*The control inside one model entry: the seven level chips, one wire-value field
per selected thinking level, **Inherit catalog** / **Non-reasoning** / **Apply**,
and the exact `reasoningEfforts` value the current selection becomes.*

## How the control reaches the row

The shipped page declares **no seat inside a model row**, and its `ModelRow` is
an internal component. The only sanctioned row-level change is shadowing the
whole `settings.section` `models` entry — a shadowed copy of the page. This plugin takes
the narrower path instead: it owns the provider-card seat, then discovers each
model row structurally.

- The row's id input carries an `aria-label` built from the shipped page's own
  `settings.models` locale namespace (`Model ID 1`, `模型 ID 1`, …). The plugin
  binds that namespace and matches the label, so discovery follows the active
  language and never depends on a hashed CSS class name.
- It appends one container per `modelEntry` and portals a React editor into it,
  so the control lives inside the model entry and disappears with the row.
- A `MutationObserver` re-runs discovery when the fold opens, a row is added or
  removed, or the page re-renders. A shipped row restructure would need the
  selector updated.

### Saving, and the page's own Apply

The editor writes through the settings transport (`settings.mutate` path ops);
the host persists the result. The shipped page keeps its **own draft** of the
model list and its own Apply writes the whole `models` array for a hand-declared
route, which can restore the `reasoningEfforts` value the card loaded at open.

To keep the editor's value authoritative, the row remembers the declaration the
user applied and, if a later settings change reverts it, writes it again — up to
three times, so a refusal is reported instead of retried forever. Applying the
effort and then using the card's Apply for another field therefore converges on
the effort value you chose.

For a catalog route the editor uses the narrow
`providers.<route>.modelOverrides.<id>.reasoningEfforts` path, which the page's
model editor does not touch — unless the page materializes a `models` array (by
editing the model list), which the adapter refuses beside `modelOverrides`. The
row's re-apply covers that case while the card is open.

## The level vocabulary is closed and ordered

`off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max` — exactly the harness's own
`THINKING_LEVELS`, in escalation order. The editor always emits the map in that
order, whatever order the chips were clicked. `off` means "do not think"; the
other six are thinking levels.

## The conversion rules (they are the adapter's)

Each chosen level becomes a key whose value is the spelling dispatch sends, so a
gateway with its own vocabulary can be renamed (`max: ultra`). The plugin
enforces `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`'s `resolveModelReasoning` rules before the
write:

| Selection | Result |
|---|---|
| `off, low, high, max` with wire values | `{ off: null, low: 'low', high: 'high', max: 'max' }` |
| `off` alone | refused — a model that cannot think uses `false` |
| nothing selected | refused — omit the field to inherit |
| a non-`off` level with no wire value | refused — it needs the value dispatch sends |
| an empty-string wire value | refused |
| a level outside the seven | refused |
| the "Non-reasoning" form | `reasoningEfforts: false` |
| the "Inherit catalog" form | the field is unset, restoring inheritance |

A declared map **replaces** the model's capability set: levels not declared are
not offered. That is why `off` must be present in the map when the user keeps
it, and why "off only" is `false` rather than `{ off: null }`.

## Where the value lands in `cordis.patch.yml`

The editor writes settings path ops; the host persists them into the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`. `reasoningEfforts` sits beside the fields the shipped row
already edits:

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      baidu-team:
        models:
          - id: deepseek-v4.1-flash
            reasoningEfforts: { off: null, low: 'low', high: 'high', max: 'max' }
            contextWindow: 1000000
            maxTokens: 256000
            input: [text, image]
            name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
```

The expanded spelling is equivalent and easier to hand-edit:

```yaml
            reasoningEfforts:
              off:
              low: 'low'
              high: 'high'
              max: 'max'
```

A model that cannot think, and one that keeps the installed catalog capability:

```yaml
          - id: acme-plain
            reasoningEfforts: false      # no selector beyond off
          - id: acme-catalog
            contextWindow: 128000        # reasoningEfforts omitted -> inherits
```

### The

plugins.description: Deterministic pre-execution tool-call guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - monotonic guard seam, operator-declared policy, decision ledger. Gate: 12/12 green, 2000 benign FP=0, injected 7/7 caught.
plugins.readme_text:
# @phm-audit/dsh-action-guard

A deterministic pre-execution tool-call guard plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`), registered through the official **monotonic guard seam** (`ctx.tools.guard`).

> DeepSeek Harness follows an "everything is a plugin" architecture. This plugin fills one concrete slot: a rules-based, operator-declared guard whose verdicts are reproducible and whose decisions are recorded.

Gate test artifact: 2009-frame deterministic command stream (2000 benign + 7 injected violations + determinism/ledger/pathological-input checks, no RNG, no network) — **0 false positives on benign, all injected violations caught by the intended rule**, 12/12 vitest cases green (2026-10-13). Run: `bash run_demo.sh`.

End-to-end smoke: the Cordis wrapper is additionally verified against the **published npm packages** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 0.0.1-rc.1 (2026-10-13) — loaded the cordis way (`ctx.plugin`, `static inject` resolved), a real tool registered, and a real `execute()` call to a non-allowlisted tool **denied with the expected R-unknown reason through the actual pipeline** (3/3 smoke cases). Version-pinned smoke: the harness is under active development; re-run `npx vitest run tests/smoke.harness.spec.ts` against your deployed version.

## What it checks (all operator-declared, all deterministic)

- **R-unknown** — tool must be in the declared allowlist
- **R-keys** — forbidden parameter keys per tool
- **R-equals** — denied parameter values per tool
- **R-bounds** — numeric parameter bounds per tool (inclusive)
- **Fail-closed** — an internal evaluation error denies with a distinctive reason (a broken guard can never silently become a hole)
- **Decision ledger** — every verdict appended to a local JSONL ledger with a chain id (correlation artifact for incident forensics; FNV-based chain id, not a tamper-proofing guarantee)

## Method lineage — PHM

This plugin is the harness-native expression of the **PHM deterministic-verification methodology** (gate-first, evidence-first), whose parent project [agent-action-verifier](https://github.com/PHM-Audit/agent-action-verifier) is validated on the **AgentDojo official benchmark with a real LLM in the loop** (no ASR/FP events in the v2.2 re-run, FP fix-cycle 16 → 1 → 0 published, all artifacts open with SHA-256 chains, third-party thread engagement on record).

What that lineage means concretely, versus the (crowded, 155-plugin) Security & Permissions category:

1. **Official third-party benchmark lineage** — the parent method is measured on AgentDojo, not only on self-built samples (verified 2026-10-13 across a 10-repo sample of direct competitors: none cites an industry-standard benchmark; the closest, dsh-defend, uses a self-built 105-sample red-team set).
2. **Cross-domain deployment record** — the same gate criteria (benign FP=0 / injected FN=0 / deterministic repeats / fail-closed / audit ledger) run in robot (Unitree official-URDF gate), traffic-flow (845k-frame NGSIM), and SDK-contract lines — a method with a track record, not a one-off plugin.
3. **Open, recomputable evidence** — every claim in this README has an on-disk artifact: gate counts in `tests/`, smoke in `tests/smoke.harness.spec.ts` against published npm versions, SHA-256SUMS manifest.

The category being crowded is stated on purpose: this plugin's value is the evidence chain and the standard-interface demonstration, not feature uniqueness.

## Channel facts (from the #9614 review — thanks @argszero)

Four properties of the guard seam that scope what this plugin's ledger and rules can claim, verified against `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts` at master (`d743267388`):

1. **The ledger is a guard-layer record, not a complete decision record.** The guard runs only when the pre-execute waterfall returned `allow` (and the user did not refuse an ask, and the call was not cancelled upstream). Denials owned by other layers never enter the guard — a complete audit record needs `tools/pre-execute` + `tools/post-execute` as writers. Our JSONL ledger describes exactly this layer and nothing more.
2. **`R-unknown` is a *name* allowlist, not a *tool* allowlist.** `execution.name` can resolve to different registered definitions across scopes (scope registrations shadow inherited entries). A same-named shadow preset is indistinguishable to the guard.
3. **PTC mode changes the traffic shape.** Model-direct calls of native tool names are denied upstream (`UNKNOWN_TOOL`) before the policy pipeline; nested sub-dispatches *do* reach the guard (inheriting `rootCallId`). Policies must therefore cover sub-dispatch argument shapes too, and the allowlist only sees what actually arrives.
4. **Structured denial metadata is channel-forced external.** A guard can only return a string; `denialInfo` in the pipeline comes from the waterfall's decision. The separate JSONL ledger is the channel's requirement, not a stylistic choice — and the refusal reason is model-facing (`Error: <reason>` is the tool result), so keep reasons short and carry the rule id (`action-guard: … (R-bounds)`) to correlate with the ledger.

**Why the guard seam (and not a `tools/pre-execute` listener):** a guard is monotonic — no other layer can force-allow what it denied — while a pre-execute listener sits in a waterfall it does not own, and one early `allow` ends the chain for everyone after it. Deterministic, synchronous, name+arguments policy belongs here; operator-visible asks belong to the waterfall.

**Mount-point note:** all guards are monotonic-deny, so the outcome is order-independent — but the *reported reason* is the first one found (global first, then scope chain farthest-first). If your policy can deny the same call from two layers, pin a single mount point to keep reported rule ids unambiguous.

## Honest scope

## Honest scope

## Honest scope

- The policy is **operator-declared** — this is not a general safety oracle, and it does not replace the harness's own permission/sandbox/approval layers; it composes with them at the guard seam.
- Same-source fix cycles are not independent stability trials. The 2009-frame gate is a mechanism demonstration, not a statistical claim.
- The guard core is a pure function (`src/guard-core.ts`, zero dependencies); the Cordis wrapper (`src/index.ts`) imports `ToolGuard` from the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` package and is smoke-tested as described above. One earlier revision imported a wrong internal-only package name; the smoke test against npm packages is the guard against that class of error.
- Ledger writes are best-effort and contained; they cannot affect the verdict path.

## Plugin shape (matches harness plugin conventions)

```ts
export const name = 'action-guard'
export const inject = ['tools']
export interface Config { policy: GuardPolicy; ledger?: { path: string } }
export default apply   // registers one ToolGuard via ctx.tools.guard()
```

## License

MIT.

plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Chess Game

国际象棋 × 两种形态：**单文件网页版**（双人同屏）+ **DeepSeek Harness Web 插件**（悬浮窗，双人/人机对战，PGN 导出）。零依赖、完全离线。

## 网页版（index.html）

两个人在同一台电脑上用鼠标轮流对战，浏览器打开 `index.html` 即玩。

- 白方先行，点一下自己的棋子（显示可走格圆点），再点一下目标格落子
- 红圈表示可吃子；被将军的王红圈高亮提示

## DSH 插件 dsh-chess-float（packages/chess-float/）

在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面里下棋：输入框工具栏 **♟ 按钮** → 弹出**可拖动悬浮窗**。

**功能**：

- 双人对战 / 人机对战（可选执白或执黑）
- 人机 AI：本地 negamax + αβ 剪枝引擎，5 级难度（入门→大师，难度=搜索深度，低难度带随机失误），毫秒级响应、零模型调用、完全离线
- 完整规则：王车易位、吃过路兵、兵升变、将杀、逼和、50 回合规则、子力不足和棋
- 悔棋（人机模式自动回退双方各一步）、SAN 标准记谱、**PGN 棋谱导出**（可导入 Lichess / chess.com 复盘）
- 主题 token 适配明暗主题

**安装**：

```bash
# 从源码（本仓库）
dsh plugin add packages/chess-float

# 离线安装（其他机器）
mkdir -p ~/plugins/chess-float
tar -xzf dsh-chess-float-1.2.0.tgz -C ~/plugins/chess-float --strip-components=1
dsh plugin add ~/plugins/chess-float
```

预构建 tarball 见 [Releases](https://github.com/x-cores/dsh-chess-game/releases)。安装后刷新 Web 页面即可看到 ♟ 按钮。

## 正确性验证

走法引擎通过标准 perft 校验（走法枚举数与国际象棋公认参考值完全一致）：

| 测试局面 | 深度 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 初始局面 | 1–4 层 | 20 / 400 / 8,902 / 197,281 ✓ |
| CPW #3（吃过路兵密集） | 1–5 层 | 14 / 191 / 2,812 / 43,238 / 674,624 ✓ |
| CPW #4（易位/升变密集） | 1–4 层 | 6 / 264 / 9,467 / 422,333 ✓ |

AI 引擎验证：深度 3 对随机对手 71 步将杀（约 44ms/步）；大师(5) 单步约 1.2s。

## 运行测试

```bash
node test-perft.js      # perft 规则校验
node test-gameplay.js   # 完整对局路径模拟（易位/过路兵/升变/SAN）
```

plugins.description: Turn your phone's Huawei XiaoYi into a remote control for the DSH agent on your own PC. DSH (DeepSeek Harness) host plugin for XiaoYi OpenClaw mode: zero third-party deps, hand-written RFC6455 WebSocket client, AK/SK auth, heartbeat, A2A streaming, SSRF-hardened inbound attachments.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-xiaoyi **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) A **DSH (DeepSeek Harness) host plugin** that connects **Huawei XiaoYi in OpenClaw mode** to your local DSH session — voice, text and images from your phone reach the agent running on your own machine. > **This is not a standalone chatbot.** XiaoYi is only the entry point; what it connects to is your local DSH session (same tools, same working directory). There is no second agent. ``` Huawei XiaoYi on your phone (anywhere) │ voice / text / images ▼ Huawei Cloud wss://hag.cloud.huawei.com/openclaw/v1/ws/link │ long-lived connection (AK/SK auth + 30s heartbeat) ▼ This plugin (runs inside the DSH host process) │ ▼ DSH session xiaoyi-listen-* ``` --- ## Prerequisites This is **not** plug-and-play. Before installing, make sure you have all three: | # | Requirement | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | **A DSH host** | DSH = DeepSeek Harness. This is a host-side plugin; without a host it cannot run. | | 2 | **XiaoYi Open Platform credentials (OpenClaw mode)** | You need `AK` / `SK` / `agentId`. These are Huawei Cloud developer credentials you must apply for yourself on the XiaoYi Open Platform. | | 3 | **Node.js ≥ 20** | The code uses the built-in `fetch` / `FormData` / `Blob`. Developed on Node 24. | > If you cannot obtain item 2, you can still read this repository as a **protocol reference implementation** — `index.js` implements the XiaoYi/OpenClaw handshake, auth, heartbeat and JSON-RPC message exchange in full. ### Where do `AK` / `SK` / `agentId` come from? **They are issued by Huawei. This project cannot create them for you and cannot tell you whether your account is eligible.** You have to apply for them yourself: 1. Register a **Huawei developer account** and complete **real-name verification** — 2. Sign in to the **XiaoYi Open Platform** and create an agent — When creating it, choose the **OpenClaw mode**. Other modes are not compatible with this plugin. 3. Take the values from the agent's detail page: - `agentId` — shown in the **AgentCard** block; - `AK` / `SK` — under **Credentials → New credential**. **The SK is displayed only once**, so copy it immediately. 4. Add your own Huawei account to the agent's **test whitelist**. Until the agent is published, only whitelisted accounts can reach it; it takes effect after a few minutes. 5. Official documentation for this mode — > Menu names, entry points and the review process are decided entirely by Huawei and may change at any time. If a step above no longer matches what you see, follow Huawei's own documentation rather than this file. > This plugin only **consumes** the three credentials. It never asks Huawei for anything else on your behalf. --- ## Features - **Zero third-party dependencies.** Only Node built-ins are used, including a **hand-written minimal WebSocket client** (RFC6455 client side: text frames, fragmentation reassembly, ping/pong, and handshake verification). Fewer packages in the plugin tree means fewer chances that one failed package takes the whole host down. - **Complete protocol implementation.** Auth signing, init handshake, heartbeat with stale-connection detection, JSON-RPC 2.0 streaming, and control messages (`clearContext` / `tasks/cancel`). - **Inbound attachments.** Images and files sent from XiaoYi are downloaded to disk, and their local paths are handed to the agent in the session (ready for `read_image` / `read`). - **Outbound online files (experimental).** Send local files back to XiaoYi (the protocol only accepts public https URLs; supports a local tunnel or a third-party image host). See the direction table below — this direction is **not** reliable. - **Session reuse.** On a cold start the plugin resumes the existing session instead of opening a new conversation every time. ### What can travel in each direction | Direction | Support | | --- | --- | | **Phone → this plugin**
(what you send to XiaoYi) | **Text, voice (transcribed) and images/files all work.** Attachments are downloaded to `~/.dsh/xiaoyi/media/` and their local paths are handed to the agent. | | **This plugin → phone**
(what you get back in XiaoYi) | **Text works** — the reply body, plus anything sent with `xiaoyi_send`. **Pushing an image or file back to the phone is unreliable**: the protocol accepts only a public https URL, and the XiaoYi client is not guaranteed to render the file part. Treat `xiaoyi_send_photo` as experimental. | > In short: **the inbound direction is the reliable one.** If your workflow depends on images or files arriving on your phone, do not rely on it. --- ## Installation ### 1. Place the source Put this directory anywhere you keep plugins. The conventional location is: ``` ~/.dsh/plugin-sources/dsh-xiaoyi ``` ### 2. Register it in your profile **Option A (recommended, one command):** ```bash # install from the GitHub repository dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/HangZhouXi/dsh-xiaoyi # or from npm (after it is published there) dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-xiaoyi ``` **Option B (edit by hand):** Edit `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`: ```jsonc { "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ // ... "dsh-xiaoyi" // ← add to bundles ] } }, "dependencies": { // ... "dsh-xiaoyi": "git+file:///C:/Users//.dsh/plugin-sources/dsh-xiaoyi" } } ``` > A plain local path dependency also works: `"dsh-xiaoyi": "file:../../plugin-sources/dsh-xiaoyi"`. ### 3. Install and cold-start ```bash dsh plugin --profile web install ``` Then **cold-start the DSH host**. (Host-side plugins are not applied by hot reload — a cold start is required.) ### 4. Provide credentials Edit `~/.dsh/xiaoyi/state.json`: ```json { "enabled": true, "ak": "XiaoYi Open Platform AK", "sk": "XiaoYi Open Platform SK", "agentId": "agentId of your OpenClaw-mode agent", "wsUrl": "wss://hag.cloud.huawei.com/openclaw/v1/ws/link", "sessionId": "", "cwd": "C:\\Users\\\\Desktop", "publicBaseUrl": "", "imageHost": "" } ``` | Field | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `enabled` | Master switch. `false` disconnects the channel. | | `ak` / `sk` / `agentId` | XiaoYi Open Platform credentials. All three are required. | | `wsUrl` | WebSocket endpoint. Leave as the default unless Huawei changes it. | | `sessionId` | The DSH session to reuse. Normally written by the plugin itself. | | `cwd` | Working directory for the session. Must be writable. | | `publicBaseUrl` | Only for outbound files in `local` mode: the public https base URL of your tunnel. | | `imageHost` | Optional default publisher for outbound files. Set `"catbox"` to make catbox.moe the default; leave empty to stay local-only. | You can also let the agent configure these at runtime with the `xiaoyi_set` tool (changes take effect immediately and reconnect). Log file: `~/.dsh/xiaoyi/xiaoyi.log` --- ## Agent tools | Tool | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `xiaoyi_status` | Channel status: whether credentials are complete, whether the WebSocket is connected, the listening session id, queue length, last error, message counters. | | `xiaoyi_set` | Update credentials / switch (`ak`, `sk`, `agentId`, `wsUrl`, `enabled`). Takes effect immediately on the live connection. | | `xiaoyi_send` | Push a short message to the current XiaoYi conversation (useful as a long-task completion notice). | | `xiaoyi_send_photo` | Send a local image or file to XiaoYi (the protocol only accepts public https; see "Outbound files" below). | | `xiaoyi_reconnect` | Force a disconnect and reconnect (after changing credentials, or when the link looks stale). | ## HTTP routes | Path | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `GET /xiaoyi/state` | JSON status. | | `GET /xiaoyi/connect` | Start the channel and make sure the listening session is ready. | | `GET /xiaoyi/disconnect` | Stop the channel. | | `GET /xiaoyi/public/` | Serves published outbound files. plugins.description: dsh字体亮度的控制
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-label-tune

Calm down the over-bright text of the DSH web GUI (dark theme): softer label tokens,
a relaxed bold weight, and lighter headings. Pure client-half plugin — no host code,
no restart, no runtime dependencies.

把 DSH Web GUI **深色主题里过亮的文字压下来**的小插件（纯客户端半边，零依赖、零构建）。

## 安装

| 场景 | 做法 |
|---|---|
| **桌面版 App**（profile 由 Electron 独占管理，CLI 装不进去） | 在 App 的插件市场里搜 `dsh-label-tune` 或填仓库地址安装 → 重启 App |
| CLI + `web` profile | `dsh plugin --profile web add github:<owner>/dsh-label-tune`，再把 `dsh-label-tune` 加进 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` |
| 本地开发（`link:`） | `dsh plugin --profile web add link:F:\path\to\dsh-label-tune` |
| 零安装（不碰 DSH） | 把仓库里的 [`dsh-label-tune.css`](./dsh-label-tune.css) 贴进 Stylus 用户样式（域 `http://127.0.0.1:19387`），或任意自定义 CSS 插件（`dsh-custom-css`、`dsh-theme-studio` 的 Custom CSS 框） |

**为什么桌面板要用市场装**：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add ...` 会被拒绝 ——
`error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。
桌面 profile 的插件只能走 App 自己的市场/插件通道。

## 生效方式

只有客户端半边 ⇒ **保存后刷新页面（F5）即生效，不需要重启 dsh web**。
只有"新增了配置层"（刚装完插件）才需要重启一次进程。

## 它改了什么

| 部位 | 官方 | 本插件 |
|---|---|---|
| 正文 `--dsw-alias-label-primary` | `bluish-50` rgb(249,250,251) **17.4:1** | `bluish-200` rgb(225,229,238) **14.5:1** |
| 正文暗档 `-primary-dimmed` | `bluish-100` | `bluish-300`（一起压，否则它比正文还亮、层级倒置） |
| 次要 `-secondary` | `bluish-300` | `bluish-300`（不变） |
| 三级 `-tertiary` | `bluish-400` | `bluish-400`（不变） |
| 加粗 `<strong>` | 与正文同色 + 字重 **600** | 颜色降到 `bluish-300` + 字重 **500** |
| 标题 h1–h3 / h4 | 700 / 600 | 600 / 500 |

对比度按底色 rgb(21,21,23) 手算（WCAG AAA 正文要求 7:1）。

**为什么加粗要单独处理**：DSH 没有给加粗单独的颜色 token（`grep strong` 在
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` 里 0 命中），它继承正文颜色，唯一差别是字重。
Windows 上微软雅黑只有 400/700 两个真实字重，**600 由 Chromium 合成加粗（涂抹）**，
笔画发糊就会显得比正文刺眼 —— 所以这里把加粗降到 500 并压暗一档。

实现全部引用官方静态变量（`var(--dsw-static-neutral-bluish-N)`），不写死 rgb，跟随上游配色。

## 微调

| 想要的效果 | 改哪里 |
|---|---|
| 正文再亮一档 | `--dsw-alias-label-primary` → `bluish-150`(15.5:1) 或 `bluish-100`(15.7:1) |
| 正文再暗一档 | → `bluish-300`(12.1:1) |
| 加粗再暗 | `strong` 段的 `bluish-300` → `bluish-400`(8.5:1) |
| 加粗用真 Bold | `strong` 段 `font-weight: 500` → `700` |
| 加粗保持原色 | 删掉 `strong` 段里的 `color` 行 |
| 标题别那么重 | 第 3 段 h1–h3 `600` → `500`，或整段删掉 |
| 浅色主题同样处理 | 去掉末尾可选段的注释 |

## 自测

```sh
node --test test/verify.mjs
```

用最小 DOM/window 桩离线跑：模块契约（id / `apply` / `inject`）、样式只注入一次、
注释配平、定稿色阶与加粗/标题规则在位、生效规则里不出现写死 `rgb()`，
以及"实测无效的那组 markdown strong token 不再出现"的回归保护。

## 卸载

移除插件即可；临时恢复可在 DevTools 里
`document.getElementById('dsh-label-tune-style')?.remove()`（仅当次会话）。

## 备注

`--dsw-font-markdown-base-strong*` 这组 token（定义在
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme/lib/styles/gradient-shadow-text.css:57-62`）
实测覆盖后观感无变化，说明渲染器不消费它，因此本插件不启用该段，只保留选择器级规则。

`peerDependencies` 里只声明了一个可选的 `@deepseek-ai/cordis`：宿主从 0.2.0-rc.1 起会在
boot 阶段按插件声明的 peer 范围做 semver 闸门（范围外的层被静默跳过，日志
`dsh: skipping profile bundle "X"`）。这里用 `>=4.0.0` 这种显式区间而不是 `^`，
避开 0.x caret 被规范化成 `<0.2.0-0` 的坑。

MIT © 2026 Upstream196

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：把本机 opencode 生态接入 DSH 模型菜单——OpenCode Go 订阅（经 opencode-api-plugin 网关）+ Zen 免费档（内嵌 opencode2api，无需网关运行）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-opencode-gateway

**English** | [中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that wires the local opencode ecosystem into DSH's model menu with two provider routes:

| Route | Endpoint | What it carries |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `opencode-gateway` | `http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1` (the local [opencode-api-plugin](https://github.com/EDDY597/opencode-api-plugin) gateway) | Everything the gateway aggregates: the OpenCode Go subscription (reading the machine's local opencode login state), OpenCode Zen, and any custom upstreams in `gateway.config.json` |
| `opencode-free` | in-process loopback proxy (default `http://127.0.0.1:10102/v1`) | The inlined opencode2api port driving the machine's own `opencode serve` backend for the Zen free tier — **no gateway process needed** |

By design this plugin ships **no usage panel**; quota display lives in the gateway's `/api/usage` and the tray.

## Features

- **Curated OpenCode Go registry** — the default menu follows the user's ZCode list (15 models); display names, context windows, effort vocabularies, vision flags and a refusal list for 41 entries, measured request-by-request and ported from [AIMFllyYS/dsh-protocom-api](https://github.com/AIMFllyYS/dsh-protocom-api) (MIT) — including the measured quirks (Go spells its disable word `off` and refuses `none`; grok/muse serve `/responses` only, which the gateway converts transparently).
- **Live model discovery** (soft-failing) — both routes mount immediately with configured/seed menus and upgrade in place once the endpoint's listing answers; a failed read keeps the current facts serving.
- **Managed backend lifecycle** — the free route spawns `opencode serve` when absent (first init ~10–20 s) and reclaims only a backend **it spawned**; one reused from the gateway stays with the gateway.
- **In-process loopback bridge** — pi-ai's transport needs a real URL, so the plugin wraps the LocalProxy functions in an HTTP listener bound to loopback only (default 10102, configurable); the listener never holds the host's event loop, so headless tasks still exit.

## System requirements

- **DSH ≥ 0.1.7-rc.2 and < 0.3.0-0** (measured peer range); verified on **0.2.0-rc.2**
- The free tier needs the opencode CLI installed; `opencode auth login` is recommended (better model list and limits, anonymous works too)
- The gateway route needs the companion gateway [EDDY597/opencode-api-plugin](https://github.com/EDDY597/opencode-api-plugin) running (`start-gateway.cmd`, `start-tray-hidden.vbs` or the tray)

## Install

### Desktop app (recommended)

Open the app, choose **Plugins** in the sidebar, click **Add plugin** and paste a local path:

```
D:/Agent/dsh-opencode-gateway
```

or a Git spec (once published):

```
github:<owner>/dsh-opencode-gateway#v0.1.0
```

Click **Install**, wait for pnpm, then click **Enable now**.

### CLI

```bash
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add "D:/Agent/dsh-opencode-gateway"
```

> The installer runs a full compatibility sandbox install, which can take many minutes on this machine; hand-composing the profile is faster — see the Chinese README.

## Configure

The plugin installs no settings UI; configuration lives in the composition layer (the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/` on the desktop app) and takes effect on restart:

```yaml
- id: opencode-gateway
  name: dsh-opencode-gateway
  config:
    gateway:
      provider: opencode-gateway
      displayName: OpenCode Go
      baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1
      apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_GATEWAY_KEY
      hiddenModels: ["free/"]
      models: []
    free:
      provider: opencode-free
      serverUrl: http://127.0.0.1:10001
      proxyPort: 10102
      opencodePath: opencode
      manageBackend: true
      zenApiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY
      disableTools: true
      internalAllowedTools: [webfetch, bash, websearch]
```

## Model manager page

DSH settings gain an **OpenCode Gateway** section (plugin v0.2.0+): one card per route (OpenCode Go / OpenCode Free) managing that route's model menu.

- **Refresh** pulls the live listing (OpenCode Go via the gateway's `/v1/models`, OpenCode Free via the inlined proxy's backend listing).
- **Checkboxes** decide what lands in the model menu (composer chip included); newly discovered models are tagged and unchecked.
- **Save checked** commits one revision-fenced settings write; the menu and chip update immediately and survive restarts; a conflict reloads the snapshot and drops staging.
- **Restore defaults** unsets that route's `models` — the menu falls back to the shipped list (or the composition `models`, when configured).

Precedence: saved settings `models` (even an empty array) > composition `cordis.patch.yml` `models` > shipped defaults. Saved entries that carry only id/name/context are enriched by the host from the measured registry (missing effort vocabulary and vision flags; an explicit `reasoningEfforts: false` is never touched). Backend-structural fields (serverUrl / proxyPort / opencodePath …) ask for a restart when changed on the page; the model menu applies live.

### Environment (`~/.dsh/.env`)

| Variable | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `OPENCODE_GATEWAY_KEY` | The gateway's Bearer token; **any non-empty value works while the gateway runs without a token** (a missing credential fails before network I/O with `MISSING_CREDENTIAL`) |
| `OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY` | Passed to the backend as `OPENCODE_API_KEY` to unlock paid models; falls back to the local opencode login state (v0.1 reads the process environment only, not the credentials seam) |

### `models[]` entries

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | The model id the endpoint accepts, forwarded verbatim |
| `name` | Selector label |
| `contextWindow` / `maxTokens` | Capacities; `maxTokens` also becomes that model's per-request default output cap |
| `reasoningEfforts` | `false` declares a non-reasoning model; a dict `{level: wire spelling}`, where only `off` may be empty (send nothing) |
| `input` | `["text","image"]` declares image input |

## How it works

- **Two routes, one adapter**: `PiAiAdapter` reads the current profiles snapshot once per operation; changed discovery facts atomically `replace` the registration — no restart, no disturbed in-flight stream.
- **Loopback bridge**: request bodies buffer into a fetch `Request`; responses stream back out. A mid-stream drop after the headers are flushed destroys the socket instead of throwing `ERR_HTTP_HEADERS_SENT` into the server callback.
- **Single retry layer**: the plugin's `retryPolicy` defaults to `normal/maxRetries 0` — retries belong to the gateway (subscription routes) or the inlined proxy (free route), never both.
- **Thinking bridging**: `reasoning_content`, `reasoning` + `reasoning_details`, and inline think tags all flow through pi-ai's delta parser into DSH's reasoning-delta collapse (the gateway strips Go routes' inline tags server-side).

## Known limits (v0.1)

- **No usage panel** (by design); quota lives in `/api/usage` + the tray.
- **`zenApiKeyEnv` reads the process environment only**; stored credential references are not resolved yet.
- **Headless one-shot tasks linger on exit**: a control run with this plugin removed lingers the same way — DSH headless base behavior, not this plugin.
- Two processes racing to spawn the same backend port (10001): a failed spawn surfaces an error and a retry succeeds; health-check-before-spawn mitigates it.

## Development

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run build   # tsdown → lib/index.js (Host, ESM); tsc -b → lib/types
pnpm run test    # vitest
```

The `lib/` build output is committed alongside the sources (git installs need no build) — run `pnpm run build` before committing code changes.

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE) © 2026 — contains the embedded opencode2api implementation ported from opencode-api-plugin (itself ported from [TiaraBasori/opencode2api](https://github.com/TiaraBasori/opencode2api), MIT; license copy at `assets/LICENSE.md`), and the OpenCode Go registry measurements from dsh-protocom-api (MIT).

plugins.description: DSH 提示词工作台：优化与多轮迭代 | Prompt Studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-studio 提示词工作台

DSH 插件。在左栏提供一个「提示词」面板，用来优化提示词、多轮迭代、保存模板与查看历史。

对标 Prompt Optimizer 的核心能力，但只做提示词，不含图像工作区、提示词花园、MCP、多消息工作区、变量与函数测试。

## 它做什么

- **优化**：给一段原始提示词，选一个已配置的模型，拿回一个改写后的提示词。
- **迭代**：在上一版基础上按方向调整（"更简洁"、"补上输出格式约束"……），形成版本链，可回退到任意一版。方向在面板内直接填，回车即开始。
- **等待有反馈**：优化与迭代期间显示进度条和已等待秒数。
- **模板与历史**：五个内置模板（通用优化 / 结构化扩写 / 精简压缩 / 加输出格式约束 / 角色设定补全），可另存；历史按时间倒序，可筛选、删除、重新载入（载入后自动切回「优化」页）。「存入历史」把结果那一栏当前的内容存成一条手写版本；「存为模板」才是存成可复用的模板。
- **在新对话中使用**：优化结果那一栏可以直接手改；改完点「在新对话中使用」，选一个工作区，插件就会新开一个对话、把这段提示词填进输入框并直接发送，省掉复制粘贴。
- **工具**：agent 可直接调用 `prompt_optimize`。

## 它不做什么

- 不管理 API Key，不直连任何第三方服务。所有模型调用都走宿主已有的 `llm` 服务（`ctx.get('llm')`），用的是你在 DSH 里已经配好的 provider / model。
- 不引入构建步骤。宿主侧是原生 ESM，浏览器侧是手写的 bundle。
- 除了 `@deepseek-ai/*` 与 Node 内置模块，没有任何依赖。

## 安装

本插件是一个 DSH **profile bundle**，不能靠 `npm install -g` 生效——它必须被装进某个 DSH profile 才会注册面板、工具与路由。

发布到 npm 后，最简单的方式是让 DSH 自己按包名安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-prompt-studio
```

或者从源码构建出 `.tgz` 再装：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/CECILIALOVE0616/dsh-prompt-studio.git
cd dsh-prompt-studio
npm pack            # 产出 dsh-prompt-studio-<version>.tgz
```

无需 `npm install`：本插件没有运行时依赖（`dependencies` 为空），peer 依赖全部由 DSH 宿主提供。

然后用 DSH 自己的安装入口把这个 tgz 装进目标 profile。两种方式二选一：

- **桌面应用**：用宿主提供的插件安装接口装上该 `.tgz`。
- **CLI**：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-prompt-studio-<version>.tgz`。

装完重载 DSH，左栏会出现「提示词」入口。

两点注意：

- `add` 只接受包名或 `.tgz` 路径，不接受目录。
- **`desktop` profile 由 Electron 桌面应用独占管理**，CLI 对它执行 `add` 会直接报
  `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。桌面场景请走应用的安装接口。
- 宿主侧代码（`lib/*.js` 里除 `client.js` 外的部分）只在 DSH 启动时加载，装完必须重载；
  浏览器侧 `client.js` 每次页面加载都会从磁盘重新取，刷新即可生效。

## 设置

在 DSH 设置页的插件分区里可以改：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultMode` | `user` | 打开面板时的默认模式（用户提示词 / 系统提示词） |
| `defaultProvider` / `defaultModel` | 空 | 默认模型；留空则用会话当前路由 |
| `maxTokens` | `4096` | 单次调用的输出上限 |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | 单次调用超时（上限 30 分钟） |
| `maxPromptChars` | `20000` | 单条提示词长度上限 |
| `historyLimit` | `200` | 历史列表一次取多少条 |
| `toolEnabled` | `true` | 是否注册 `prompt_optimize` 工具 |

除 `toolEnabled` 外都支持热更新：改完立刻生效，不用重启。**`toolEnabled` 需要重启 DSH**——它决定工具在启动时注不注册，这类开关不享受热更新。

也可以走环境变量：`DSH_PROMPT_STUDIO_MODE` / `_PROVIDER` / `_MODEL` / `_MAX_TOKENS` / `_TIMEOUT_MS` / `_TOOL`。优先级是「插件设置 > 环境变量 > 内置默认」。

## 数据放在哪

每个工作区各自一个 SQLite 库：`<工作区>/.dsh-prompt-studio/prompt-studio.db`。三张表：

- `prompts`：提示词版本（含 `parent_id` 版本链）
- `runs`：每次模型调用（优化 / 迭代）
- `templates`：模板（内置 + 自建）

用的是 Node 内置的 `node:sqlite`，不需要额外装数据库。库是按工作区隔离的，换个项目就是另一套历史。

## 工具：`prompt_optimize`

```
prompt_optimize(prompt, mode?, direction?, provider?, model?)
  → { optimized, provider, model, elapsedMs }
```

- `prompt`：必填，原始提示词。
- `mode`：`system` 或 `user`，默认 `user`。
- `direction`：给了就按迭代模式走（在上一版基础上按方向调整），不给就是通用优化。
- `provider` / `model`：不传则用会话当前路由。传了非法值会直接报错，不会静默回退到别的模型。

调用过程中可以用 `exec.signal` 中断。

## 结构

```
lib/
  index.js    入口：Config、注册工具、挂路由、热更新钩子
  schema.js   schemastery 软导入（解构 {Schema} 会静默拿到 undefined）
  config.js   配置解析（设置 > 环境变量 > 默认），含 volatile cell 解包
  llm.js      对宿主 llm 服务的封装（streamText / listRoutes / assertRoute）
  prompts.js  提示词工程：优化 / 迭代的系统提示词，以及容错清理
  store.js    node:sqlite 存储层
  routes.js   浏览器侧 HTTP API（/dsh-prompt-studio/*）
  tools.js    prompt_optimize 工具定义
  client.js   浏览器 bundle（手写，无构建步骤）
```

## 排查

| 症状 | 原因 |
| --- | --- |
| 插件完全没出现 | `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 没并入 profile，或者没重载 DSH |
| 左栏有入口但面板打不开 | 客户端 id 与左栏项的 `id`、主区的 `key` 不一致；或 `exports.inject` 少了 `slots` |
| 设置页没有本插件的分区 | `Config` 没导出，或 schemastery 软导入拿到的不是 builder |
| `tool "prompt_optimize" is already registered` | agent preset 里重复声明了这个工具 |
| LLM 调用报 503 / undefined | `ctx.get('llm')` 是空的 |

## 许可

MIT © CECILIALOVE0616

plugins.description: Progress companion for the dsh web pet: folds durable todo/write and goal/change session events into the pet's status bubble, so it reports how much work is left - not just what the model is doing right now.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pet-progress

**English** · [中文说明](README.zh.md)

**A progress bar for your desktop pet.**

The [dsh web pet](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-pet) shows what the agent
is doing *right now* — thinking, calling a tool, done. It has no way to show how
much of a long task is finished, so a task that is 90% done looks exactly like
one that just started.

This plugin fixes that. It reads the todo lists and goals your agent already
writes to the session, and folds them into a percentage bubble on the pet.
A session that never writes a todo list isn't left blank either — there the
bubble falls back to a plain line saying what is happening right now.

## Install

One command, using the plugin's full GitHub URL:

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/Elefseus/dsh-pet-progress
```

This requires the [dsh web pet](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-pet) to be
installed. If it is missing, the plugin stays loaded but publishes nothing —
you'll see a note in the dsh log rather than a crash.

**Restart DSH afterwards** — bundles are read only at startup, so the plugin
won't mount until you do. The bubble then appears on its own the next time your
agent writes a todo list or starts a goal; there is nothing to switch on.

For a named profile, use `dsh plugin --profile <name> add …`.

## What you'll see

A small bubble above the pet, updated whenever the todo list or the goal changes:

| Situation | Bubble |
| --- | --- |
| Todo list, one task in progress | `3/7 · 43%` titled with that task |
| Todo list, several tasks in progress | `3/7 · 43%`, naming none |
| Long-lived goal with no todos | `2/8 轮` — the goal's round budget |
| Goal blocked | The block reason, in place of progress |
| No todo list and no goal | A plain line with no percentage — `等待模型响应`, `正在调用工具`, or the model's own words, led by `当前过程` or `最近输出` |

The bubble fades out about 30 seconds after the last progress update, so a
finished turn doesn't leave a stale percentage on screen. It comes back by itself
if the work resumes.

Several sessions can be open at once — the most recently active one owns the
bubble.

## Checking the full list

The bubble is one line, so there's a button for the rest: click **进度** on the
pet panel and the complete todo list is written to the dsh log.

## Good to know

- **It never over-reports.** A todo whose status the plugin doesn't recognise
  counts as *not done*. If every entry in a write is unreadable, the plugin
  treats it as "no information" and keeps what it had.
- **It won't guess.** If several tasks are in progress at once, the bubble shows
  the count and names none — naming the wrong task would be worse than naming
  nothing.
- **It reads, it doesn't judge.** A percentage comes from the todo lists and
  goals your agent writes; the plugin never infers progress from how long
  something has been running. Without either, it shows the plain activity line
  instead of a number.

## Requirements

| | |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `>=0.1.7-rc.1` |
| `@linxin666/dsh-pet` | `>=0.4.0` (peer) |
| Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |

The plugin binds to the pet's plugin-seam contract (`announce`,
`registerPanelAction`, and the `session/event` channel); an older pet does not
expose all three.

## Configuration

```ts
apply(ctx, { enabled?: boolean, heartbeatMs?: number })
```

With `enabled: false` nothing mounts. `heartbeatMs` defaults to `10000`.

## Using it from code

The plugin is host-only (no client bundle). The pet service is available as
`ctx.pet`, and the same three seams the pet publishes are what this plugin uses:

| Seam | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| `ctx.on('session/event', …)` | Reading `todo/write`, `goal/change`, and the turn/step/tool/message events behind the activity line |
| `ctx.pet.announce(…)` | Publishing the progress bubble |
| `ctx.pet.registerPanelAction(…)` | The `进度` panel button |

Adjust `PROGRESS_TTL_MS` and `MAX_TRACKED_SESSIONS` in
[`src/progress.ts`](src/progress.ts) to change the fade-out and how many sessions
are tracked at once.

## Development

`src/*.ts` is the source of truth; `lib/` is committed build output, because the
cordis loader does no transpilation. **After editing `src/`, rebuild and commit
`lib/` with it — CI fails if the two drift apart.**

```bash
node build.mjs              # rebuild lib/ from src/
node --test src/*.test.ts   # 55 tests, node:test only
```

To work on the code, skip installing and point the profile at your checkout:

```jsonc
// ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-pet-progress": "file:<absolute path to this directory>" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["…existing…", "dsh-pet-progress"] } }
}
```

A `bundles` entry alone is not enough — the package must also be a dependency.
If the path contains non-ASCII characters, write it as a `file://` URL. Restart
the app afterwards.

Node is pinned in `package.json` `engines` and exercised in CI at `22.19.0` and
`24.x`.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop up dsh-pet-progress          # update to latest default branch
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "<repo>#<tag>"           # pin a tag instead (reproducible)
```

## More

- [Design notes](docs/DESIGN.md) — why the plugin is built this way: the event
  gap it fills, why it's a sibling rather than a patch, what it reports, and the
  two non-obvious details (deferred mounting, and an announcement slot with no
  retract).

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆插件：分层任务记忆 + 关系图谱 + 索引常驻稳定前缀；零运行时依赖，另附同源的 Agent skill 形态
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lmmarr

DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆插件。**lmmArr** = *long-memory, as a task graph*。

一句话定位：让「我在做什么、做到哪、和什么有关」**零成本常驻**，并且**按任务只读那一块记忆**。

## 它解决什么

上下文压缩会丢细节，RAG 只能"再找回来"，而每开一个新会话，模型都得重新被告知你是谁、在做什么。
本插件的做法不是压缩，而是**换一种组织方式**：

| 层 | 文件 | 谁在维护 | 成本 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 原始 | `YYYY-MM-DD.md` | 人手工写，append-only | 零（不进上下文） |
| 任务 | `MEMORY_<任务ID>.md` | 模型按需读写 | 只在召回该任务时进上下文 |
| 索引 | `MEMORY.md` | 工具自动重写 | **常驻**（投影进系统提示，确定性、有预算） |

关键在最后一行：索引被**逐字**放进了稳定前缀，所以它是"免费"的 —— 引擎的前缀缓存第一次算完就留住了。
索引里**不含时间戳**，同一份记忆投影出的文本逐字相同；这是缓能否命中的充要条件，也是本仓 `docs/design.md` 里那条论证的落地。

## 安装

从源码直接挂载（免构建，当前可用）：

```bash
dsh web --patch ./cordis.yml
```

从 npm 安装（包尚未发布，发布后可用）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-lmmarr
```

自检（改配置后务必看一眼，dsh 对配置错误是**静默忽略**而不是报错）：

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A8 "id: lmmarr"
```

## 配置

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `dir` | `<cwd>/.dsh-memory` | 记忆目录 |
| `depth` | `1` | `lmmarr_context` 的默认邻域跳数 |
| `writeEnabled` | `true` | 设 `false` 整插件只读；写工具会**明确拒绝并说明原因**，而不是静默无效 |
| `guidance` | `true` | 是否注入记忆协议到系统提示 |
| `hotMemory` | `true` | 是否把索引投影进上下文 |
| `maxProjectionCharacters` | `2000` | 投影的字符预算；超出先丢关系、再裁任务，且**显式说明截断** |
| `bodySoftLimit` | `16000` | 单个任务正文的软上限；超出只在索引里提示「该拆了」，不自动改写 |
| `timeoutMs` | `10000` | 工具执行超时 |

## 工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lmmarr_index` | 读完整索引（任务表 + 关系图 + 一致性问题）。索引已在上下文里，**只在需要全表或要报告问题时调用** |
| `lmmarr_context` | 读一个任务 + 其直接邻域，**其余文件一个不碰**。这是读记忆的正道 |
| `lmmarr_upsert` | 建/改一个任务记忆文件。同 id 复用即更新，**未传的字段一律保留** |
| `lmmarr_link` | 声明 `child`（拆解）/ `depends`（前置）/ `relates`（弱关联）；`child`/`depends` 必须无环，成环的边会被拒绝且**什么都不改** |
| `lmmarr_forget` | 删一个任务文件并带走它的关系。破坏性操作，只在用户明确要求或条目确实错了时用 |

## 架构

```
src/
  index.ts       插件入口：只做「按 dsh 规范挂载」这一件事
  guidance.ts    记忆协议 → systemPrompt.section（告诉模型何时该用、何时绝不该写）
  project.ts     热记忆投影 → systemPrompt.section（确定性、有预算、无时间戳）
  service.ts     Cordis 服务 lmmarrMemory（工具只是它的一层视图）
  memory/        记忆内核：graph（图谱）/ store（存储）/ nodefs / cli
  index/         未接入的检索路线探索（embedding / 一致性哈希 / 任务归纳），论证见 docs/design.md
```

三条设计约束，都写进了测试：

1. **内核对外零依赖**。`graph.ts` / `store.ts` 只认一个 `FsPort` 接口，所以能完全离线单测。
2. **写路径唯一**。「采集问题 → 重写索引 → 返回快照」收敛在 `service.refresh()` 一处。顺序不可换：重写索引会把悬空边自愈掉，先写再查就永远报不出问题。
3. **引导与工具分离**。工具的 `description` 只说"能做什么"；"什么时候用、什么时候绝不该写回"必须常驻系统提示，模型才会形成纪律。

## 开发

```bash
npm run verify      # 类型检查 + 全部测试 + 构建
npm test            # 只跑测试（node --test，无需构建）
npm run build       # tsc → lib/
npm pack            # prepack 会自动构建；产物只含 lib/ + cordis.patch.yml + 文档
npm run verify:name # 发布前包名闸门
npm run verify:mount # 挂载探针：真实 boot 一次，确认 5 个工具与两段引导真进了模型可见面（不花模型调用）
```

发布流程与坑清单见仓库内的 `docs/publishing.md`（维护者文档，不随 npm 包发布）。

## 同一套记忆，装成 Agent skill

`skill/` 是同一份记忆内核的 skill 形态（`SKILL.md` + `references/` + 零依赖脚本），供按 skill 机制加载的宿主使用。它与 dsh 插件**同源**——都编译自 `src/memory/`，不会分裂成两份实现：

```bash
npm run sync:skill   # src/memory → skill/scripts，并安装到 ~/.workbuddy/skills/lmmarr-memory
```

`skill/tools/agents-probe.mjs` 是一个零依赖的**能力门**：探测当前框架有没有子代理，输出 `MODE delegate|self-compress`，给「探索性工作该委派出去、还是只留结论」这条纪律分叉用。

## 与 dsh-mnemon 的关系

本插件的架构骨架（引导层、视图/注意力分离、服务化、打包与发布形态）参考了 [`dsh-mnemon`](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon)。
刻意的取舍：

**借鉴**：系统提示里常驻的记忆协议；把能力 `provide` 成服务、工具只做视图；`params` 走 JSON Schema 子集（每个 `object` 必须显式 `additionalProperties`）；发布形态（`lib/` 构建产物 + `dsh.bundle.patch` + `exports`/`files` 白名单）。

**不跟**：多 provider 后端（9 个外部记忆服务）、React 客户端 UI、Git 同步与 GitHub 登录、子代理协调器、`view_route`/`view_action` 的双层间接寻址。这些在 mnemon 的规模下是必要的，在我们这里主要变成维护面。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中一键开关 REA MCP 服务器（rea-mcp），并向模型暴露配套的开关工具 rea_mcp_toggle；选择按 profile 持久化，重启后依然生效。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-rea-mcp-toggle

一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）bundle 插件：**在 Harness Web UI 里一键开关 REA MCP 服务器**，并把同一个开关交给模型（工具 `rea_mcp_toggle`）。选择按 profile 保存，重启后依然生效。

> 适用：DSH `0.2.1-alpha.2`（web profile）。零运行时依赖（只用 Node 内置模块 + dsh 宿主服务）。

---

## 1. 项目解决什么问题

REA（[Reverse Engineer Anything](https://github.com/morluto/rea)）通过 MCP 以 stdio 方式接入 DSH。它的工具集非常大：**开启时是 170 个 `mcp__rea__*` 工具**，这些工具的 schema 会随**每一次**请求一起发给模型。

实测同一实例、同一时刻，`Tool.listTools` 的返回体大小：

| REA 状态 | 工具数 | tools payload |
|---|---|---|
| 开启 | 251 | **722,353 字节** |
| 关闭 | 81 | **94,807 字节** |

差价 **627 KB** 全部是那 170 个工具的定义。它们**每次都进请求**，于是产生两种浪费：

1. **token 费用**：不管这一轮到底用不用逆向工具，都在为这 627 KB 付费（长会话里反复累积）；
2. **进程与内存**：REA 的 MCP 子进程常驻（单进程约 240 MB），只有关掉才会退出。

而 DSH 自带的「插件开关」（Plugin Manager 里把 `rea-mcp` 行禁用）**对这一行无效**——原因见第 6 节，这不是配置问题，是 patch 层的机制决定的。所以本项目提供了能真正生效、且能持久化的开关。

**典型场景**：平时关着，等真要分析二进制 / APK 时再打开；或者反过来，只在需要省 token 时临时关闭。

---

## 2. 主要功能

### 2.1 UI 开关（主入口）

会话标题栏（Session header）里的一个小按钮，与「费用明细」等控件并列：

- 显示 **`REA 开`** / **`REA 关`**，绿点表示当前状态；
- 点一下切换：**即时生效，不需要重启 Harness**；
- 切换失败时按钮直接变成 **`REA 失败`**（红框），鼠标悬停显示具体原因 —— 不会静默无效；
- 鼠标悬停还会显示当前工具数与配置行 id。

### 2.2 模型工具 `rea_mcp_toggle`

| action | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `status` | 读当前开关状态、工具数、是否已持久化、状态文件路径 |
| `set` | 切换（需 `enabled: true/false`）；**幂等**，重复同向不发写、不产生副作用 |
| `probe` | 诊断：Loader 行状态、REA 工具数、缝是否在位、服务可用性、Remote endpoint 解析情况 |
| `selftest` | 用 **Web UI 调用的同一条 Remote 网关路径**自检本插件（用来区分「UI 坏了」还是「Host 坏了」） |

UI 按钮与这个工具**共用同一套实现**（同一 service 的同一个方法），不存在两份逻辑。

### 2.3 状态持久化

选择保存在插件自己的状态文件里：

```
%DSH_PROFILE_DIR%\.rea-mcp-toggle.state.json     例如 {"enabled": false, "savedAt": "..."}
```

写入是原子的（临时文件 + rename）。重启后由家目录层的一行 `!!js` 缝读取该文件，**开机即按选择生效**（关闭状态下开机根本不会拉起 REA）。

### 2.4 工具可见性真正变化

关闭时 170 个 `mcp__rea__*` 工具从**模型可调用工具列表**中消失（不只是「不执行」）；开启时全部回来。

### 2.5 进程生命周期

- 开启：拉起 REA 的 stdio 子进程（**每次切换恰好 1 个**）；
- 关闭：dispose 该行，回收子进程、注销工具；
- 关闭后**不会自己复活**（曾有一个「关闭后子进程又起来」的缺陷，已修并可复现验证）。

---

## 3. 安装方法

### 3.1 前置条件

- 已安装 DSH，且 REA 已作为 MCP server 注册在**家目录层** `%DSH_HOME%\cordis.patch.yml`，形如：

  ```yaml
  - insert:
      - id: rea-mcp
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
        config:
          serverName: rea
          transport: stdio
          command: '<HARNESS_ROOT>\node\bin\node.exe'
          args: ['<NPM_GLOBAL>\node_modules\rea-agents\scripts\rea.mjs', 'mcp']
          env: { REA_MCP_INPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE: compact }
          toolCallTimeoutMs: 900000
          failOnStartupError: false        # 硬约束：REA 坏了也不能让 harness 起不来
  ```

- 该行 id 必须是 **`rea-mcp`**（本插件按这个 id 定位；其它 id 会被明确拒绝，不会误伤）。

### 3.2 安装本 bundle

本插件以**路径链接**方式安装，因此包目录内需要有指向 DSH 安装的 `node_modules` 链接（Node 从包的**真实目录**解析 bare import；本插件运行时只 import `node:fs`，但编译/探针脚本需要）：

```powershell
cd plugins\dsh-rea-mcp-toggle
node scripts/link-deps.mjs
# 通常不需要参数：脚本会自己找 harness（见下），失败时才需要显式给根目录
# node scripts/link-deps.mjs "<HARNESS_ROOT>"
```

**脚本如何找到 harness**（按顺序，每个候选都会被 marker 校验，**错的目录不会静默胜出**）：

| 顺序 | 来源 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 命令行参数 | `node scripts/link-deps.mjs "<root>"` |
| 2 | `<repo>/.harness-root` | 一行写根目录；模板见 `.harness-root.example`；已被 git 忽略。标准位置都描述不了的布局用这个 |
| 3 | `DSH_HARNESS_ROOT` | 环境变量 |
| 4 | 平台标准安装位置 | Windows：`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs`、`%ProgramFiles%`、`%ProgramFiles(x86)%`、`%LOCALAPPDATA%` 下的 `dsh-desktop` / `DeepSeek Harness` / `deepseek-harness`，并在其 `resources/harness` 与 `harness` 处探测；macOS：`/Applications`、`~/Applications`；Linux：`/opt`、`/usr/local/lib`、`/usr/lib` |
| 5 | 正在运行的 Harness | 由进程的 `node.exe` 路径反推安装根，因此装在非标准目录也能找到 |

判定「是 harness 根」的条件：同时存在 `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/{cordis,dsh,dsh-tools}` 与 `node_modules/js-yaml`。本仓库自身**被显式排除**（它的 `node_modules` 是链接，否则会自我链接）。

然后在会话里让模型执行（需要 danger-full-access 或当次审批）：

```
plugin_manager → install_bundle → <本目录绝对路径>
```

**安装后必须重启一次 dsh-desktop。** Host 半边的模块是进程启动时导入的；不重启时插件行会处于 `failed to import` 或停在旧版本。

### 3.3 安装家目录层的「开关缝」（必须，一次）

这是**唯一**需要手改家目录层的地方。在你已有的 `rea-mcp` 行里加一个行级 `disabled`（不要放进 `config` 里面）：

```yaml
      - id: rea-mcp
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
        config:
          # ...原有内容保持不动...
        # ── 开关缝：由 dsh-rea-mcp-toggle 插件读取 ──
        disabled: !!js >-
          Boolean(ctx.get('profileContext')?.dir) && (() => { try { return process.getBuiltinModule('node:fs').readFileSync(process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').join(ctx.get('profileContext').dir, '.rea-mcp-toggle.state.json'), 'utf8') && JSON.parse(process.getBuiltinModule('node:fs').readFileSync(process.getBuiltinModule('node:path').join(ctx.get('profileContext').dir, '.rea-mcp-toggle.state.json'), 'utf8')).enabled === false } catch { return false } })()
```

**改前先备份**：`Copy-Item .dsh\cordis.patch.yml .dsh\cordis.patch.yml.bak-<时间戳>`

这段表达式是**安全降级**的：状态文件不存在 / JSON 损坏 / `profileContext` 不可用（例如离线 `dsh --dump-config`）时一律返回 `false`＝保持启用，**不会让 harness 起不来**。

### 3.4 安装后自检

```powershell
node scripts/acceptance.mjs        # 校验缝与状态文件在同一口径上
```

再在会话里执行 `rea_mcp_toggle {action:"selftest"}` —— 它走的就是 Web UI 的 Remote 网关路径。

---

## 4. 使用方法

### 4.1 日常：点按钮

标题栏的 **`REA 开` / `REA 关`** 按钮，点一下即可。不需要重启。

### 4.2 让模型帮你切

```
把 REA 关掉，我在省钱          → 模型调用 rea_mcp_toggle {action:"set", enabled:false}
REA 现在开着吗？               → 模型调用 rea_mcp_toggle {action:"status"}
UI 按钮点了没反应，帮我看看     → 模型调用 rea_mcp_toggle {action:"selftest"}
```

### 4.3 关闭 / 禁用的几种情况

- **临时关**：点按钮。状态文件写 `enabled:false`，当前进程立即生效（工具消失、子进程回收）。
- **永久不再启用**：把手改的那段 `disabled: !!js` 缝从家目录层删掉（保留其余内容），该行即恢复为无条件启用。
- **彻底卸载**：见第 8 节。

---

## 5. 输入输出示例

以下均为**真实运行结果**（本机实测，`compact` schema profile）。

### 5.1 查询状态

输入：

```json
{ "action": "status" }
```

输出（REA 关闭时）：

```text
REA MCP (rea-mcp) is OFF: the mcp__rea__* tools are not callable; the choice is saved.
entry=rea-mcp module=@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client
enabled=false persisted=false tools=0 seam=true
stateFile=<PROFILE_DIR>\.rea-mcp-toggle.state.json
```

输出（REA 开启时）：

```text
REA MCP (rea-mcp) is ON: 170 tool(s); the choice is saved.
entry=rea-mcp module=@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client
enabled=true persisted=true tools=170 seam=false
stateFile=<PROFILE_DIR>\.rea-mcp-toggle.state.json
```

> `seam=false` 是正常的：即时开启会清掉该行**进程内**的 `disabled` 键（`probe` 里显示 `rawDisabled=null`），开机时缝会重新求值（那时是 `seam=true`）。

### 5.2 关闭 REA

输入：

```json
{ "action": "set", "enabled": false }
```

输出：

```text
REA MCP (rea-mcp) is OFF: the mcp__rea__* tools are not callable; the choice is saved.
entry=rea-mcp module=@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client
enabled=false persisted=false tools=0 seam=false
```

同时 `%DSH_PROFILE_DIR%\.rea-mcp-toggle.state.json` 变为：

```json
{ "enabled": false, "savedAt": "2026-10-13T17:59:27.803Z" }
```

### 5.3 开启 REA

输入：

```json
{ "action": "set", "enabled": true }
```

输出（子进程握手完成后）：

```text
REA MCP (rea-mcp) is ON: 170 tool(s); the choice is saved.
enabled=true persisted=true tools=170 seam=false
```

### 5.4 幂等：重复同向不发写

连续两次 `{ "action": "set", "enabled": false }`，第二次不会重写状态文件
（实测文件 `LastWriteTime` 与内容完全不变），也不会新增 patch 行。

### 5.5 诊断

输入：

```json
{ "action": "probe" }
```

输出（节选）：

```text
seam=false reaTools=0 stateFile=...\.rea-mcp-toggle.state.json
stateFileExists=true stateFileValue=false services={"loader":true,"tools":true,"typert":true,"pluginManager":true,"typertGateway":true}
row id=rea-mcp-toggle composite=include:rea-mcp-toggle module=dsh-rea-mcp-toggle rawDisabled=false effectiveDisabled=false fiberState=2 parentTree=include
row id=rea-mcp composite=include:rea-mcp module=@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client rawDisabled=true effectiveDisabled=true fiberState=4 parentTree=include
```

读数要点：`effectiveDisabled=true` 且 `fiberState=4`（disposed）＝该行确实已停；
`reaTools=0` ＝ 模型侧看不到 REA 工具。

### 5.6 UI 自检（判断是 UI 坏还是 Host 坏）

输入：

```json
{ "action": "selftest" }
```

输出：

```text
gateway reaMcp/getState ok -> {...}
gateway reaMcp/setEnabled ok -> {...}
restoredTo=false
```

`selftest` 会先记住你的选择，结束后**原样恢复**（诊断不改变开关）。

### 5.7 安装后的效果对照

| 观察点 | 关闭 | 开启 |
|---|---|---|
| `Tool.listTools` 里 `mcp__rea__*` | 0 个 | 170 个 |
| `listTools` payload | ≈ 94.8 KB | ≈ 722.4 KB |
| 该实例的 REA 子进程 | 0 个 | 1 个 |
| 开销最大的部分 | — | 170 个工具 schema 进每次请求 |

---

## 6. 为什么不能用 profile 层的 `disabled`（关键设计决定）

DSH 的 patch 分层是：**bundle 层 → profile 层（`%DSH_PROFILE_DIR%\cordis.patch.yml`）→ 家目录层（`%DSH_HOME%\cordis.patch.yml`）→ `--patch` 覆盖**，后者覆盖前者。

`rea-mcp` 行是**家目录层**用

# 使用情况 · dsh-key-usage **DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏用量面板** —— 按通道看 Token、缓存命中率、成本，以及余额与订阅窗口。 [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-key-usage?style=flat-square)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-key-usage) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue?style=flat-square)](./LICENSE) [![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-web%20%7C%20desktop-4d9fff?style=flat-square)](#兼容与运行要求) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-339933?style=flat-square)](#兼容与运行要求) [![topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0e7490?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://img.shields.io/badge/listed-dsh--plugin.org-4d9fff?style=flat-square)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/xyl886/dsh-key-usage) [界面预览](#界面预览) · [安装](#安装) · [数据与权限](#数据权限与联网) · [功能](#功能) · [成本与价目](#成本与价目) · [常见问题](#常见问题) · [更新记录](./CHANGELOG.md) · [开发](#开发)
--- 装上之后，左侧边栏会多一项「使用情况」，点开就是整页用量面板：**总览（Key 清单 + 活跃热力图）、使用明细、项目用量、按模型、会话用量、余额与配额**。数据全部来自你自己的机器，**默认不联网**。 ## 界面预览 > 截图为**早期版本**，当前界面以实际页面为准；本批未重拍。设计意图与更早的原型见 [`docs/prototype/`](./docs/prototype/)（不代表当前界面）。

## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-key-usage dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-key-usage ``` > 桌面端 profile 受应用保护，部分版本会拒绝该命令（本机实测报 `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`），此时改用应用内 **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**。装完都要**退出并重新打开 DSH** 才生效。 ## 数据、权限与联网 **读什么** | 读取对象 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-usage/usage-ledger.json` | 用量台账（天 × 通道 × 模型，含官方成本） | | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-usage/provider-snapshots.json` | 余额 / 窗口的**回落值** | | `$DSH_HOME/profiles//cordis.yml` | 通道清单（只做文本提取，**不执行**其中的 `!!js`；取不到回退 `cordis.patch.yml`） | | 宿主 `sessionPersistence` 服务 | 项目 / 会话 / 单会话详情 / 按小时（只开只读句柄，不自行解压会话文件） | | 宿主 `credentials` 服务 / 进程环境变量 | 查余额时的 API Key（只用于拼 `Authorization`） | | 随包 `data/litellm-model-prices.json`、`$DSH_HOME/dsh-key-usage/model-prices.json`、`fx-rate.json` | 聚合价目与汇率缓存 | **写什么**（只有三处，都在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-key-usage/`）： - `snapshot.json` —— 统一快照：6 个 Tab 的数据（含明细），每 5 分钟本地重建一次，点「刷新」时整体重算； - `model-prices.json` —— 点「刷新价目」成功后写入的聚合价目副本（校验不过不覆盖旧文件）； - `fx-rate.json` —— 汇率缓存（成功才写，12 小时内直接复用）。 三个文件都不含任何密钥；宿主的 `provider-snapshots.json` 与 profile 配置一律只读。**不读凭据文件、不改宿主配置、所有端点仅接受回环请求** —— 完整约束见 [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md)。 **会联网的三个动作，都要你触发**： | 动作 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | 打开「余额与配额」 | 按通道查官方余额 / 窗口接口；6 秒超时、64 KiB 上限、结果缓存 60 秒（点「刷新」强制重查），失败回落本机快照并写明原因 | | 点「刷新价目」 | `POST /dsh-key-usage/pricing/refresh`：先 `raw.githubusercontent.com`、失败再试 jsDelivr 镜像；服务端 20 秒预算、响应上限 12 MiB，校验不过**不覆盖**已有文件；界面最多等 30 秒 | | 打开页面 / 切换显示币种 / 点「刷新汇率」 | `GET /dsh-key-usage/fx`：主 `open.er-api.com`、备 `api.frankfurter.app`；6 秒超时、64 KiB 上限、12 小时 TTL 内不联网；失败回落缓存，再失败用默认 7.1 并在界面明示 | **不做开机拉取、不做定时轮询、不在其它端点里隐式联网**。 ## 功能 **总览** - **Key 清单** —— 每通道一行：类型、今日与近 30 天调用量、余额或订阅窗口占用、30 天成本（带来源角标）； - **活跃热力图** —— 近 9 个月按日 Tokens，格子按可见区间的**活跃日五分位**分档（p20 / p40 / p60 / p80）。 **使用明细** - 今日 / 周 / 月 / 总计 / 自定义范围 + 按通道筛选，全页联动； - 六张统计卡（调用次数、Tokens、缓存读、缓存命中率、日均 Tokens、成本）+ 环比趋势对比； - 通道占比条、按天 / 按小时图表（单日范围自动切 24 小时）、可排序可展开的每日细目。 **项目用量 · 按模型 · 会话用量** - 分别按工作目录、通道 + 模型、单个会话聚合，支持搜索、按通道筛选与排序；会话按日期分组，可切换显示已归档会话； - **会话详情抽屉**：首条真实提问全文、工作区、通道、时长、四类 tokens 与命中率、成本与来源角标、逐模型占比，有结算样本时给 24 小时迷你图； - 会话列表可按成本 / 命中率 / 调用数排序，标「跨 N 天」，可展开看模型构成；首屏 50 条 + 「加载更多」；点行内工作目录跳到「项目用量」并只看该项目。 **导出** - 上面四处都能把**当前筛选后**的数据导出为 CSV 或 JSON（CSV 带 UTF-8 BOM）。 **余额与配额** - 每个通道一张卡片：官方余额（总余额 / 赠送 / 充值）或订阅窗口占用（5 小时 / 本周 / 本月 + 重置时间）；成功带「实时」标签与查询时间，失败写明原因并回落快照； - **卡片可点击展开**：展开后是该通道近 30 天用到的模型**单价表** —— 模型 · 四档单价（每百万 tokens）· 来源（官方价 / 聚合 / 估算 / 无依据）· 「· 部分」· 「错峰中」· 近 30 天 tokens； - 工具条：**¥ RMB / $ USD 切换**（全页金额按汇率折算显示，折算值带 `≈`）、刷新汇率、刷新价目、成本口径 ⓘ。 ## 成本与价目 **取值优先级（四层）**：`官方账单`（台账记录的厂商账单，不会被覆盖）→ `内置官方价目` → `LiteLLM 聚合价` → `台账反推均价`；都没有则显示 `—`。 | 角标 | 含义 | | --- | --- | | **官方** | 台账记录的厂商账单金额 | | **官方价** | 按插件**内置的厂商官方价目**算出（随包发布、自动生效） | | **聚合** | 按随包的 **LiteLLM 聚合价目**算出（第三方维护、美元计价） | | **估算** | 三层都没收录时，按台账反推的均价推算 | > 「**· 部分**」是口径提示、不是错误：该条聚合价目缺一档缓存价，缺的那档按**未命中价**代；两档都缺的条目按「不支持缓存计价」处理，不标「部分」。 **内置价目**（18 条，2026-10-13 抓取；随包发布的 `data/pricing-catalog.yml`，**不要改它**，升级会覆盖）： | 通道 | 模型 | 币种 | 来源 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `deepseek-official` | deepseek-flash · deepseek-v4-flash · deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp · deepseek-v4-pro | CNY | [api-docs.deepseek.com](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing) | | `moonshotai` | kimi-k3 · kimi-k2.7-code · kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed · kimi-k2.6 | CNY | [platform.kimi.com](https://platform.kimi.com/docs/pricing/chat) | | `zai` | glm-5.3 · glm-5.3-flash · glm-5.3-flashx · glm-5.2 · glm-5 | USD | [docs.z.ai](https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing) | | `openrouter` | deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash · anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5 · anthropic/claude-opus-5.5 · openai/gpt-6.1-sol · openai/gpt-6-astra | USD | [openrouter.ai](https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models) | - 币种按各家定价页**原样记录**（CNY / USD 并存，显示时按汇率折算）；文档没写清的档位**留空而不是猜**（例如 Kimi K2 系列未公布缓存写入价 → 该档按 0 计）； - **错峰**：窗口按**本地时间**判定（`起止相同` = 全天，`from > to` = 跨午夜），可限定每天 / 仅工作日 / 仅周末；只有**单日范围**会用当天的 24 小时分布算错峰占比并加权，跨天按标准价（有意保守）。DeepSeek 按官方口径：**北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00 为高峰，其余（含周末）为空闲半价**；插件没有法定节假日日历，**节假日按高峰价算**（偏高、保守）。 **聚合价目**（[BerriAI/litellm](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm) 的 [`model_prices_and_context_window.json`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/blob/main/model_prices_and_context_window.json)，MIT，原文随包在 [`data/litellm-LICENSE.txt`](./data/litellm-LICENSE.txt)）： - 随包快照 2,797,533 B、sha256 `6b5e1ee7…63e403`、upstream commit `30b8db32…`、抓取 2026-10-14（详见 [`data/README.md`](./data/README.md)）；按实现口径 **2697 条可定价条目 / 1546 个模型名**； - **本地刷新副本优先于随包快照**；两份都读不到时这一层整体失效，不影响其它口径； - 匹配按通道别名表，别名命中多条时取「键 `/` 段数最少 → 键名字典序」的第一条；别名不命中时**只有模型名全库唯一才用**，否则跳过 —— **不猜通道**； - 它能命中的条目基本都被内置官方价目覆盖，所以**对现有通道通常不产生新数字**，作用是给以后新增的通道 / 模型兜底。 ## 常见问题
装了新版，界面怎么还是旧的 宿主必须**完全退出**再重开（不是关窗口、不是刷新页面），重开后再 `Ctrl + Shift + R` 清一次浏览器缓存。桌面端最容易遇到 —— 重装插件也不会重新导入服务端模块。
Windows 上 pnpm 安装报 EPERM（无法创建符号链接） 未开启开发者模式时 Windows 不允许创建符号链接。本插件唯一的宿主 peer 依赖（`@deepseek-ai/cordis`）是 **optional**，pnpm 不会为它建链接，因此不会触发。更早的版本（≤ 0.1.4）遇到时：改用 **Plugin Hub** 安装，或开启开发者模式 / 以管理员身份运行。
余额卡片显示「该通道未配置 API Key」 需要宿主 `credentials` 能解析该通道的 `apiKeyEnv`，或该变量存在于宿主进程环境里。解析不到时插件不会去读凭据文件，而是直接回落快照。
成本显示为 0 / 「无计费」/ 一直显示「估算」 免费额度与本地端点没有成本概念；由会话事件补位的日期、以及项目 / 会话 / 按小时视图也没有官方成本。展开通道卡片可以看到每个模型的单价与来源：显示「估算」说明三层价目都没命中，只能按台账反推均价推算。
点了「刷新价目」，成本数字怎么没变 多数情况下**本来就不会变**：聚合价能命中的条目基本都被内置官方价目覆盖，剩下的往往是多候选（按「不猜通道」跳过）。刷新本身只做一件事：把上游最新价目写到本机（校验不过不覆盖旧文件），平时不联网、也不轮询。
汇率显示「用默认汇率 7.10，未能联网」 说明两个上游都取不到、本机也没有可用缓存。此时跨币种金额仍会按这个兜底值折算，工具条上会显式标出「默认值」与失败原因；点「刷新汇率」可重试。
会话标题怎么不是我说的第一句话 标题按优先级取：宿主投影缓存 → 会话 header 字段 → **首条人类提问**（跳过 ``、斜杠命令这类宿主注入文本，压平空白、截 60 字）；确实没有提问时显示「（无提问）· <短 id>」。
热力图的颜色深浅怎么定 按可见区间内**活跃日的五分位**分档（p20 / p40 / p60 / p80），不是固定阈值。
卸载后侧边栏还有图标 客户端资源需要刷新页面，服务端需要退出重开 DSH。桌面端的卸载同样在 Plugin Hub 里操作。
## 兼容与运行要求 | 项 | 要求 | | --- | --- | | DeepSeek Harness | 桌面端 0.2.x（客户端 slot：`sidebar.panellist` + `main`）；web profile 同样支持 | | Node.js | ≥ 22（宿主内置） | | 运行时依赖 | 无。`react` / `react/jsx-runtime` 由宿主注入；服务端只用 Node 内置模块；唯一 peer 是 `@deepseek-ai/cordis`（optional） | | 可选服务 | `sessionPersistence`（缺失时项目 / 会话 / 按小时为空态）、`credentials`（缺失时余额只读快照） | | 价目文件 | 内置价目 `data/pricing-catalog.yml` 与聚合价目快照 `data/litellm-model-pri

plugins.description: Hedged requests for streaming /v1/messages LLM calls: fires a second attempt when response headers miss a deadline and races them, retries immediately on 5xx/504, passes through 4xx/429, with statistics.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ttft-hedge

TTFT 优化：对发往 LLM 中继 /v1/messages 的流式请求做对冲（hedged request）——deadline 内未收到响应头则并行发第二个请求，先到先用；5xx/504 立即重抽；4xx/429 原样返回。附统计工具与 stats 文件。

由 dsh-super-injector dev_scaffold_plugin 生成。

## 构建与注入

```bash
bash scripts/build.sh
# 注入器环境内：dev_inject_plugin <本目录>
```

plugins.description: 给 DSH agent 一个"回答前会出声"的机制：目标锚点、似曾相识检索、重复检测、引用核对、按语境分块的警报判据。零第三方依赖，核心不调 LLM。
