plugins.readme_text:
HarnessMate — a DeepSeek Harness plugin

Put the DeepSeek Harness agent running on your own computer into your pocket.
English · 中文

`harness-mate` is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin. It connects the DSH agent running on your machine to **[HarnessMate](https://github.com/liaosiliangCodeLife/harness-mate-plat)** — a small self-hostable platform that gives that agent a phone app and a browser entry. The agent keeps running on your own computer, with your files and your approvals. HarnessMate is just the door: open it from the phone in your pocket or from a browser anywhere. ## What it does - **Chat from anywhere.** Send the agent a message from the phone app or the web UI; streamed replies arrive with a typing indicator. - **Files both ways.** Send the agent files from the phone; the agent can send files back. - **Approvals on your phone.** When the agent asks to run a risky tool, the request is pushed to you — approve or deny from the chat, instead of being tied to the computer. - **Keeps your machine in charge.** Tools run locally with your permissions, under your DSH profile. HarnessMate never executes anything on its own. - **Model-agnostic and profile-aware.** It talks to whatever model your DSH profile is configured with. - **macOS and Windows.** ## Install You need a HarnessMate agent — a `bot_id` and a `bot_key`. Open the platform (`https://harness.alltman.com` by default), sign in, go to **个人空间 → 创建智能体**, and copy both values. **The key is shown only once.** > DeepSeek Harness desktop **v0.2.0-rc.2 or newer**, started at least once, is required. ### Option A — install as a plugin (recommended) ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:liaosiliangCodeLife/harness-mate-dsh ``` Once the package is on npm this shortens to `dsh plugin --profile web add harness-mate`. Then put your credentials in the **profile** config — `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` (macOS) / `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml` (Windows): ```yaml - insert: - id: harness-mate name: 'harness-mate' config: gatewayUrl: 'wss://ws-agent.alltman.com:1443/ws' botId: 'YOUR_BOT_ID' botKey: 'YOUR_BOT_KEY' ``` ### Option B — run the installer Download the release zip, unpack it, and run the installer in the plugin folder. It registers the plugin, links it into the profile, writes your credentials, and backs up the previous config — 3 steps, no manual editing. ```bash # macOS cd harness-mate ./install.sh # or: ./install.sh ``` ```powershell # Windows powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 ``` ### Both options finish the same way **Quit DeepSeek Harness completely** (menu bar / tray icon → Quit — not just close the window) and start it again. Then send the agent a message from the phone app or the web UI: **a reply means it works.** Logs are written to `~/.harness-mate-trace.log` (`%USERPROFILE%\.harness-mate-trace.log` on Windows). Detailed instructions, FAQ and the full configuration reference: **[INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md)**. ## Configuration Every field lives under `config` in the plugin's `cordis.patch.yml`; change them and restart DSH. | field | default | meaning | |---|---|---| | `gatewayUrl` | HarnessMate's gateway | The WebSocket gateway the plugin connects to | | `botId` / `botKey` | — | This agent's identity on the platform (**required**) | | `workspace` | your home directory | Root directory the agent may read and write | | `dmPolicy` | `open` | `open` · `allowlist` (with `allowFrom`) · `disabled` | | `approvalTimeoutMs` | `300000` | Tool-approval timeout; a timeout is treated as a denial | | `maxReplyChars` | `4000` | Maximum length of a single reply | | `forwardReasoning` | `false` | Also forward the agent's reasoning to the chat | ## Screenshots | Home | Personal space | Chat | |---|---|---| | ![home](assets/screenshot-home.png) | ![personal space](assets/screenshot-space.png) | ![chat](assets/screenshot-chat.png) | ## Repository layout ``` harness-mate-dsh/ ├── index.js # the plugin (DSH / Cordis) ├── package.json # manifest: dsh.bundle patch + icon ├── cordis.patch.yml # default plugin config ├── icon.svg # plugin icon shown in DSH ├── locale/ # zh / en title and description ├── install.sh # macOS installer ├── install.ps1 # Windows installer (PowerShell) └── INSTALL.md # full install guide, FAQ, manual install ``` ## Related - **[harness-mate-plat](https://github.com/liaosiliangCodeLife/harness-mate-plat)** — the platform itself (Vue 3 + Flask + Go WebSocket gateway + Docker), MIT licensed and self-hostable. - The sibling **Hermes** channel adapter lives in that repository under `plugin/hermes/`. ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: DSH Web plugin: configure priority-ordered provider/model/reasoning-effort routes for subagent delegation, and gate subagent_fork
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-subagent-injection（子智能体注入）

[![CI](https://github.com/Minhyuin/dsh-subagent-injection/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Minhyuin/dsh-subagent-injection/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

一个 DSH Web 插件：在**设置 → 内置插件**里增加一页「子智能体注入」，用来集中配置主代理委派子智能体时使用的
provider / model / 推理强度，并按优先级顺序自动注入到 `subagent` 调用上，失败自动顺位重试。

## 它解决什么

DSH 自带的 `subagent` 工具本身接受 `provider` / `model` / `reasoning_effort` 参数，但**必须由主代理自己决定**
要不要传、传什么。本插件把这件事从提示词里搬到界面上：

1. 设置页维护一张**有序路由表**（可拖动排序），每行是一个 provider + model + 推理强度。
2. 主代理每次调用 `subagent`，插件都会在工具真正执行前把参数改写为路由表中的候选，顺序即优先级。
   主代理不需要被提示词提醒 —— 它自己传不传参数都一样。
3. 某个候选因为**路由本身的问题**失败（provider 不可达、密钥被拒、模型不存在、限流、5xx…），自动换下一个候选，
   主代理与用户都不需要干预；只有整张表都失败才会报错，并把每次失败的原因列出来。
4. `subagent_fork` 开关：取消勾选后该工具被禁用，调用会被**自动改派为 `subagent`**（而不是报错），
   因此仍然享受上面的路由顺序。

## 界面

**设置 → 内置插件 → 子智能体注入**：

| 控件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| 启用调度 | 总开关。关闭后插件完全不介入任何工具调用。 |
| 允许 subagent_fork | 见上文第 4 条。 |
| 路由表 | 每行：`⠿` 拖动柄、序号、provider、model、推理强度。 |
| 推理强度 | **仅当该模型声明了推理强度时才显示**；未声明的模型没有这一列，也不会注入 `reasoning_effort`。 |
| 刷新 / 保存 | 保存直接写回 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，**无需重启**即可生效。 |

候选模型与推理强度**不读 `cordis.yml` 的原始配置，而是读运行中的模型目录**
（`session/modelCatalog`，即 `llm.resolveModelInfo` 的结果），所以界面里出现的档位一定是适配器真正接受的那些；
未声明的模型不会显示推理强度选择器。保存时还会丢弃"上一个模型残留的、当前模型并不支持的"推理强度。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-subagent-injection
```

重启 `dsh web`（或桌面端），打开 **设置 → 内置插件 → 子智能体注入**。安装器也接受 Git 地址、tarball 与本地绝对路径。

**需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更新版本**：`plugin/package.json` 的 `engines.dsh`（以及嵌套的 `dsh.engines.dsh`）声明为
`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`，宿主更旧时请先升级 DSH。宿主侧只依赖 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（DSH 运行时本来就会提供），
浏览器侧只依赖 shell 基线模块表里的 `react` / `react/jsx-runtime` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`。

**开发仓库本体**（`link:` 到源码树，改代码立刻生效）：

```jsonc
// C:\Users\User\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-subagent-injection": "link:<本仓库>/plugin" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ /* …, */ "dsh-subagent-injection" ] } }
}
```

`<本仓库>/plugin` 需要有一条同名 Junction/软链到 `node_modules`，或者用 `plugin_manager` 的 bundle 安装完成这两步。
装载后 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里会出现本插件的条目，设置页的保存也写在同一个条目上：

```yaml
- id: subagent-injection
  name: dsh-subagent-injection
  config:
    enabled: true
    fork: false
    routes:
      - provider: pioneer
        model: deepseek-v4.1-flash
      - provider: deepseek
        model: deepseek-flash
        effort: max
```

## 分类与使用场景

**分类**：开发效率 / 模型与推理配置。**使用场景**：子智能体委派、多模型路由与失败降级、推理强度固定、关闭 `subagent_fork`。

## 隐私与权限

宿主端只注册**一个** `ctx.on("tools/execute", …)` 监听器，只读 `ctx.config` 与运行中的模型目录：不发起网络请求、
不读写文件、不访问环境变量、不执行动态代码，也没有安装脚本。浏览器端是自注册 bundle，只通过 `remote.settings`
的 `describe` / `update` 读写本插件自己的配置项。唯一被写入的位置是当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里本插件的条目。

## 提交合规（dsh.so）

`npm run check:submission`（`tools/check-submission.mjs`）对着 `plugin/` 的 **npm tarball** 逐条核验
[dsh.so 的接受标准](https://www.dsh.so/zh/submit/)：`dsh` 兼容信号、README 安装说明、SPDX 许可证与许可证文件、
仓库名/包名的 id 规范、`engines.dsh` 版本声明、可扫描源码、以及"出厂内容只有 `files` 声明的那些"。
安全扫描本身在服务端由 **vet** 判定，本地只检查它的结构性前提（`dsh.bundle.patch` 指向的文件必须存在、入口必须可解析、
`engines.node` 不得低于 22）。

发布流程：`master` 上的推送由 `.github/workflows/release.yml` 推导版本并打 tag，**打上 tag 后**
`.github/workflows/publish.yml` 把同一个版本写进 `plugin/package.json` 并 `npm publish`（需要仓库 secret
`NPM_TOKEN`）。

## 为什么改代码之后要分别重启

DSH 的 HMR 只监听 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 与 `package.json`，**插件源码不在监听范围内**：

- **改配置**（设置页保存、直接编辑 `cordis.patch.yml`）→ 立即热生效，不用重启。
- **改宿主端代码**（`plugin/lib/index.js`）→ 必须彻底退出 DSH 再打开；只关窗口或刷新页面不够
  （宿主端是 Node 侧 `require` 进来的，模块缓存跟随进程生命周期）。
- **改浏览器端代码**（`plugin/lib/client.js`）→ **刷新页面即可**。宿主每次请求都现读磁盘，并用
  `{mtimeMs, ctimeMs, size}` 算出 `rev` 做 URL 指纹。

## 目录

```
plugin/                 插件本体（profile 里 `link:` 的就是它，也是 npm 上发布的那个包）
  package.json          dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client(platform: web) + engines.dsh
  cordis.patch.yml      bundle 补丁：插入 id=subagent-injection 的条目
  lib/index.js          宿主端：tools/execute 监听器（注路由 + 失败顺位 + fork 改派）
  lib/client.js         浏览器端：自注册 factory bundle（无构建步骤，手写 jsx）
  README.md             随 tarball 发布的安装/配置说明（npm 页与市场条目显示这一份）
  LICENSE               MIT 全文（根目录那份的副本，check:submission 会比对两者）
LICENSE                 仓库许可证（GitHub 识别的那一份）
tools/                  开发期工具，不参与插件运行，也不进 tarball
  test-host.mjs         宿主端 18 项断言
  test-client.mjs       浏览器端 bundle 形状 / slot 契约 / 渲染 / 保存断言
  check-submission.mjs  对着 npm tarball 核验 dsh.so 的提交规范
  asar-map.mjs          asar 读取/解包/grep（读 DSH 上游源码用）
  asar-snip.mjs         在压缩过的 bundle 里打印正则命中附近的片段
```

本地验证：

```sh
npm install                      # 只为拿到宿主端 import 的 @deepseek-ai/schemastery（DSH 运行时本来就会提供）
node tools/test-host.mjs         # host: 18 checks passed
node tools/test-client.mjs       # client: bundle shape, slot contract, render and save checks passed
npm run check:submission         # 26/26 checks passed（对着 tarball 核验提交规范）
```

仓库本身没有构建步骤：两半都是手写纯 JS，客户端半边是自注册 bundle。唯一的安装项是 `schemastery`
（`Config` 的 schema 库），在 DSH 里它是 peer dependency。

CI（`.github/workflows/ci.yml`）在每次 push/PR 上跑这三条。

`master` 上的推送由 `.github/workflows/release.yml` 调用 `.github/scripts/release.sh` 推导版本并建 Release，
规则与提交类型对应如下（对齐参考项目的 release 规则）：

| 提交 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `feat:` | 次版本号 +1 |
| `fix:` `perf:` `revert:` `docs:` | 修订号 +1 |
| 类型后带 `!`，或正文含 `BREAKING CHANGE:` | 主版本号 +1 |
| `ci:` `chore:` `refactor:` `style:` `build:` `test:` | 不发布 |

版本算术没有交给 `mathieudutour/github-tag-action`：它用 API 把最新 tag 与 HEAD 做 compare，
全新仓库第一次 push 时没有任何 tag，比较结果为空，会一直打印 “0 commits … no release”，首个 Release 永远发不出来。

**打上 tag 之后**，`.github/workflows/publish.yml` 把同一个版本写进 `plugin/package.json`
（`npm version <tag> --no-git-tag-version`）并 `npm publish`，所以 git tag、registry 上的版本与 README 里的
`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-subagent-injection@X.Y.Z` 三者始终一致。发布需要仓库 secret `NPM_TOKEN`
（npm automation / granular token，对 `dsh-subagent-injection` 有 publish 权限）。

## 实现要点

- 宿主端只注册**一个** `ctx.on("tools/execute", …)` 监听器，这是 DSH 唯一允许在工具真正执行前观察并改写的扩展点。
  监听器通过改写 `exec.name` / `exec.schema` 实现 fork→subagent 改派，通过改写 `exec.arguments` 注入路由，
  并在每次尝试结束后还原。
- 路由优先级 = 数组顺序。若主代理自己指定了 provider/model，该选择会作为**第一个候选**先行尝试，
  失败后再按配置顺序顺位。
- 只有「路由类」失败才顺位重试；取消、工具自身 bug 等一律原样上报，避免重复副作用。
- 浏览器端是手写的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 自注册 bundle，只依赖
  `react` / `react/jsx-runtime` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`（都在 shell 的基线模块表里），
  所以不需要打包器；设置页通过 `settings.plugins.tab` 插槽挂进「内置插件」分区，读写走 `remote.settings`
  的 `describe` / `update`（远端一律返回 `{ok, value}` / `{ok, error}` 信封，客户端先拆信封再当数据用）。

plugins.description: Doxygen comment workflow for C/C++ (including Qt) sources: file headers, functions, module groups, trailing and short comments, plus a scan that flags comments whose signature fingerprint went stale. Installable as a DSH plugin (skill).
plugins.readme_text:
# doxygen-comment

**English** | [中文说明](#中文说明)

An agent skill for generating and maintaining [Doxygen](https://www.doxygen.nl/) comments in C/C++
(including Qt) sources. It is not a snippet collection but a pipeline an AI coding assistant can drive
end to end: **read the function signature → generate or complete the comment → mark the comment stale
when the code changes**.

## Features

- **Locate a function by line number or by name.** `parse_function.py` parses C/C++ signatures with
  tree-sitter and prints JSON (function name, return type, parameters and their direction, start line,
  signature fingerprint, optional body snippet). Read-only, no side effects.
- **Six templates.** File header / function / module head / module tail / trailing `/**< */` / short
  `@brief`, matching the editor snippet prefixes `doxygen_source`, `doxygen_fun`,
  `doxygen_module_head`, `doxygen_module_end`, `doxygen_rear`, `doxygen_nom`.
- **Fill in, never rewrite.** When a Doxygen block already exists above a function, only the missing
  fields are added and the fingerprint is refreshed; existing wording and line order are kept. A file
  that already carries an `@file` block is skipped.
- **Signature fingerprint.** Every function block ends with `@doxygen_sig_fp <16 hex digits>`; `--scan`
  compares the current signature against it and marks "signature changed, comment outdated" functions
  as `stale`, which is what makes repository-wide upkeep possible. Pure formatting changes (whitespace,
  `*`/`&` placement) do not change the fingerprint.
- **Nothing is written by default.** A diff is printed first; `--write` applies it while preserving the
  target file's CRLF/LF style and its UTF-8 / UTF-8-BOM / GBK encoding.
- **CJK-text friendly.** The scripts force UTF-8 output, avoiding the mojibake a GBK Windows console
  would otherwise cause.

## Repository layout

```
doxygen-comment/
├── SKILL.md                  # skill body: workflow, script contract, template list
├── README.md                 # this file
├── LICENSE                   # MIT
├── requirements.txt          # Python dependencies
├── package.json              # DSH plugin manifest — declares dsh.bundle
├── cordis.patch.yml          # plugin insert row (id: doxygen-comment, name: dsh-doxygen)
├── index.js                  # registers the bundled skill when installed as a plugin
├── assets/
│   └── cpp.json              # the six templates as editor snippets (optional)
├── references/
│   └── examples.md           # before/after examples, Qt cases, common mistakes
└── scripts/
    ├── parse_function.py     # read: locate a function + parse its signature (no side effects)
    ├── gen_doxygen.py        # write: render / insert / complete / fingerprint / diff / scan
    └── install_snippets.py   # optional: merge the snippets into a VS Code style IDE
```

## Installation

### 1. Get the source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/FantastyQAQ/dsh-doxygen.git
```

The repository is named `dsh-doxygen` while the skill is named `doxygen-comment`: when you drop it into
a skills directory, **name the directory `doxygen-comment`**.

### 2. Install it

Two ways in — as a DSH plugin bundle, or by copying the folder into a skills directory.

**As a DSH plugin.** The repository root declares `dsh.bundle`, so it installs like any other plugin:

```bash
dsh plugin add github:FantastyQAQ/dsh-doxygen
```

`index.js` registers `SKILL.md` as the `doxygen-comment` skill and resolves `${SKILL_DIR}` for you,
so no path guessing is needed.

**By copying the folder.** The directory is self-contained; the scripts contain no
project-specific paths:

| Host | Skills directory |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `~/.dsh/skills/doxygen-comment/` |
| Claude Code | `~/.claude/skills/doxygen-comment/`, or a project's `.claude/skills/` |
| CodeBuddy CN / WorkBuddy | `~/.codebuddy/skills/doxygen-comment/`, `~/.workbuddy/skills/doxygen-comment/` |

```powershell
# e.g. install for Claude Code at user level
git clone https://github.com/FantastyQAQ/dsh-doxygen.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.claude\skills\doxygen-comment"
```

### 3. Dependencies

Python 3.10+ is required:

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
# equivalent: pip install "tree-sitter>=0.22" "tree-sitter-cpp>=0.21"
```

Tested with `tree-sitter 0.26.0` + `tree-sitter-cpp 0.23.4`; the scripts support the `Language`/`Parser`
construction API both before and after 0.22. On Windows, always type `python` (`python3` is an alias
trap in some environments).

### 4. Verify

```bash
python scripts/parse_function.py --file demo.cpp --list
```

If it prints an array of functions, the installation works.

## Quick start

The commands below are run from the skill root; replace `: <path>` with your source path.

### 1) Locate a function and parse its signature

```bash
python scripts/parse_function.py --file src/rtc.cpp --line 42 --body-lines 30
python scripts/parse_function.py --file src/rtc.cpp --name RTC_Init
python scripts/parse_function.py --file src/rtc.cpp --list      # list all (no body_snippet)
```

The output is UTF-8 JSON:

```json
{
  "name": "RTC_Init",
  "return_type": "int32_t",
  "params": [
    {"type": "const RTC_Config_t*", "name": "config", "direction": "in"},
    {"type": "uint32_t*", "name": "status", "direction": "out"}
  ],
  "start_line": 42,
  "end_line": 68,
  "is_definition": true,
  "signature": "int32_t RTC_Init(const RTC_Config_t* config, uint32_t* status)",
  "fingerprint": "ac50cb812857de87",
  "file": "…/rtc.cpp"
}
```

`direction` is decided by the script using the parameter-direction rules (the "参数方向判断规则"
section of `SKILL.md`); take it as given.

### 2) Generate a function comment

Hand the signature plus the body snippet from the previous step to the model and let it produce the
description JSON:

```json
{
  "brief": "初始化 RTC 外设",
  "params": [
    {"name": "config", "desc": "RTC 配置参数"},
    {"name": "status", "desc": "初始化状态码，非 0 表示失败"}
  ],
  "return_desc": "0 成功，非 0 为错误码",
  "retval": "none",
  "details": "调用前需保证 32.768kHz 晶振已起振。"
}
```

Then render, preview and apply:

```bash
python scripts/gen_doxygen.py --file src/rtc.cpp --line 42 --kind fun --doc doc.json --diff
python scripts/gen_doxygen.py --file src/rtc.cpp --line 42 --kind fun --doc doc.json --write
```

Without `--diff`/`--write` it prints JSON (with `status`, `notes`, `changed`, `diff` fields).

### 3) Other template kinds

```bash
# file header (inserted at the first line of the file)
python scripts/gen_doxygen.py --file src/rtc.cpp --kind source \
  --brief "RTC 驱动" --note "依赖 32.768kHz 晶振" --log-desc "创建" --diff

# module group head / tail (used as a pair)
python scripts/gen_doxygen.py --file src/rtc.cpp --kind module --line 30 \
  --group rtc_api --title "RTC API" --brief "RTC 对外接口" --desc "全部函数可重入" --diff
python scripts/gen_doxygen.py --file src/rtc.cpp --kind module-end --line 120 --diff

# trailing comment / short comment (no signature parsing needed)
python scripts/gen_doxygen.py --file src/rtc.h --kind rear --line 18 --text "已发送帧数" --diff
python scripts/gen_doxygen.py --file src/rtc.h --kind nom  --line 25 --brief "RTC 状态枚举" --diff
```

### 4) Repository-wide scan (read-only)

```bash
python scripts/gen_doxygen.py --scan src
```

It returns `{"summary": {...}, "items": [...]}` where every function carries a `status`:

| scan status | meaning | what to do |
|---|---|---|
| `missing` | no Doxygen block above it | add one with the function-comment flow |
| `stale` | block exists but the fingerprint no longer matches (the code changed) | review the description, then refresh |
| `partial` | block exists but fields are missing (e.g. no `@param`) | fill in only what is missing |
| `ok` | complete and fingerprint matches | leave it alone |

The scan skips `.git`, `build`, `libs`, `node_modules` and similar directories. Do **not** rewrite
hundreds of files in one go: group by status and let the user pick the scope first.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-approval-watch

Global approval / question reminder overlay for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

When any session has a pending tool approval, a plan review, or a user question, a persistent floating overlay pops up at the bottom-right of the DSH web UI (draggable, collapsible). Clicking an entry jumps straight to the session that needs you, so approvals never stall the flow because they are out of sight.

## How it works

- The host half (`lib/index.js`) is intentionally empty — all behavior lives in the browser half (`lib/client.js`), which registers a shell overlay entry.
- The `dsh.client` manifest injects the browser half into the web client runtime.

## Install

Install it from the **DSH Plugin Market** (Settings → Plugin Market), or add it to your profile bundle stack manually — see `cordis.patch.yml`. Prebuilt; no build step required.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: edit an already-sent user prompt and resend it - forks a child session whose inherited prefix stops just before that message.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-edit-resend

**改掉已经发出去的那句话，然后重新问一遍。**

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）Web GUI 的客户端插件：
给消息操作条加一个 ✏️ 按钮，把某条已发送的用户提示词改掉、分叉重发。

![编辑并重发对话框](docs/dialog.png)

---

## 为什么需要它

DSH 没有「编辑已发送的用户消息并重新生成」这个功能，这是**架构决定的**，不是漏做：
会话是一份 append-only 的事件日志（`session.v4.jsonl` + 崩溃检查点），任何已经落盘的
`user/message` 都不能被原地改写。目前消息上能做的操作只有 **复制** 和 **在新对话中分支**。

本插件补上语义上最接近的等价物：

1. 读出某个已完成轮次开头那条用户提示词（文本 + 事件 seq）；
2. `sessions.fork({ atSeq: seq - 1 })` —— 分叉出一个子会话，其继承前缀正好停在这条提示词之前；
3. 打开子会话，把编辑后的文本作为新提示词发给它。

**原会话完全不动**：不改历史、不改标题、不留痕迹。

## 用法

在任意已完成轮次的底部操作条里点铅笔图标，位置是 `复制 → 👍 → 👎 → ✏️ → 分支`：

![按钮位置](docs/button.png)

- 弹出的对话框预填该轮次的原始提示词，直接改；
- 点「分叉并发送」，界面自动跳到新会话，新提示词已经在跑。

下图的子会话就是分叉出来的：上面那个空的「已完成」是切点留下的合成收尾（见
[已知取舍](#已知取舍)），然后是改写后的提示词和模型的新回复。

![结果](docs/result.png)

按钮只在轮次开头确实是用户提示词、且该提示词之前还有事件（`seq > 0`）时可用；
通知唤醒、命令触发的轮次上按钮是灰的，悬停会说明原因。

## 安装

DSH 插件按 profile 安装。以桌面版默认 profile 为例：

```powershell
$profile = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop"
git clone https://github.com/stefanydevitoqz-creatorPPP/dsh-edit-resend.git "$profile\plugins\dsh-edit-resend"
```

在 `$profile\package.json` 的 `dependencies` 里加一行：

```json
"dsh-edit-resend": "file:plugins/dsh-edit-resend"
```

在 profile 目录里安装：

```bash
pnpm install
```

> 桌面版自带 pnpm，可以这样调：
> `& "<DSH>\resources\runtime\pnpm\bin\pnpm.mjs" install`
> （用 `resources\runtime\primary-runtime\...\node.exe` 跑，或任何 ≥ 8 的 pnpm）

最后让它挂载：**重启 DSH**，或者在侧栏的**插件**页面里把 `dsh-edit-resend` 打开
（市场对纯客户端插件是热挂载的，不用重启；浏览器刷新一次即可看到按钮）。

> ⚠️ **不要**在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里用裸包名手动加这一行。loader 解析插件入口时是从宿主
> 闭包出发往上找 `node_modules`，走不到 profile 目录，裸包名会解析失败。市场写入的是绝对
> `file://` URL —— 那才是对的做法。

## 卸载

1. 从 `$profile\package.json` 的 `dependencies` 删掉 `"dsh-edit-resend"` 那一行；
2. 在 `$profile` 里跑一次 `pnpm install`；
3. 删掉 `$profile\plugins\dsh-edit-resend` 与 `$profile\node_modules\dsh-edit-resend`。

## 工作原理

| 环节 | 做法 |
| --- | --- |
| 挂载点 | ui-chat 声明的 `conversation.chat.assistant-actions`（`list` / session 作用域）。每条已定稿的助手消息都会渲染该条目，owner prop 是 `{ messageId }`，组件另外拿到 `useChat` / `sessionId` / `t` 等框架 share |
| 定位提示词 | 用 `messageId` 在 `useChat` 快照的 `timeline.turns` 里反查轮次号，再 `locations.getTurn(turn)` + `nodes.get(key)` 找该轮第一个 `kind === 'user'` 节点，取 `data.seq` 与 `data.content` |
| 分叉 | `ctx.get('sessions').fork({ sessionId, atSeq: seq - 1, increaseTitle: true })`。`atSeq` 是**闭区间**切点，所以 `seq - 1` 恰好排除掉这条提示词 |
| 发送 | `sessions.using(childId, { source }, ref => …)` 拿到子会话 binding，经 `binding.ctx.get('conversation').sendSession(binding.session, text, [], 'queue')` 提交 —— 和输入框走完全相同的宿主准入路径（含本地提交回显） |
| 依赖 | 只 `require('react')` 和 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`（两者都在平台 module seed 里），样式用 DSW CSS 变量自绘，**零非基线外部依赖** |

文件很小：`lib/index.js` 是宿主半边的空 `apply()`（只为让包出现在 loader 里），
`lib/client.js` 是全部逻辑。

## 已知取舍

- **不是原地编辑**：产物是**新会话**。这是 append-only 日志下能做到的上限。
- **子会话会多一个空的「已完成」尾巴**：切点落在该轮 `turn/start` 与 `user/message` 之间，
  属于宿主**明确支持**的「在未结束轮次内截取」，它会补上合成的结束事件。这是切点的忠实
  表现，不影响上下文正确性。
- **刻意不切更早**：切到 `turn/start` 之前，会把携带原提示词的 `agent/inbox/spliced` 插入
  事件一起继承过来，而它的移除事件不会跟着继承 —— 子会话的输入队列里就会残留一条待处理
  消息。切在 `seq - 1` 保证队列是干净的。
- **附件不搬运**：原消息若含图片/文件，对话框会提示；v1 只搬文本。

## 开发

宿主加载的是 `node_modules/` 里的**副本**，不是 `plugins/` 里的源码。改完源码后：

```powershell
Copy-Item "$profile\plugins\dsh-edit-resend\lib\client.js" `
          "$profile\node_modules\dsh-edit-resend\lib\client.js" -Force
```

再让市场重新挂载（插件页关掉再打开），浏览器刷新一次。

## 许可

MIT © 2026 stefanydevitoqz-creatorPPP

---

## English summary

A client-side plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH) Web GUI that gives you the closest honest equivalent of *"edit a sent message and regenerate"*.

DSH cannot rewrite history: a session is an append-only event log, so a durable `user/message` is
immutable. This plugin instead reads the opening user prompt of a completed turn, forks a child
session whose inherited prefix stops immediately before that prompt
(`sessions.fork({ atSeq: seq - 1 })`), opens it, and submits your edited text as its new prompt
through the very same host admission path the composer uses. The original session is never touched.

A pencil button appears in the turn action strip (`copy → 👍 → 👎 → ✏️ → branch`) and the dialog is
prefilled with the original prompt.

Most notable limitation: the result is a **new session**, never an in-place edit, and the child
inherits a small synthetic "completed" turn tail from the cut point (the plugin deliberately cuts at
`seq - 1` rather than before `turn/start`, so the child's input queue stays clean).

MIT licensed.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-paper-studio —— 论文方案（编排层）+ DSH 插件 V3

把「**论文方案**」（＝论文框架 + 方法论 + 工作流）做成**可编排、可机检、可在对话里直接用**的一套东西：
一个 **CLI 编排层**（`bin/studio.cjs` + 唯一真源 `references/pipeline.json`）＋ 一个 **DSH 插件**（`plugin/`，**对话驱动、无面板、双模式、五种写作模式**）。

> 判据不在这里：门、体裁、模板、篇幅预算、教训都在 `references/` 的真源文件里，本仓只做**编排与桥接**。

## 它解决什么

- **不用记流程**：在对话里说「启用论文插件」「帮我写论文」，插件先**确认一次**，再用**可点击选项**给你五种模式（每项一行小字），选定后**按该模式差异化提问**。
- **不空转**：每个动作都返回**退出码与读数**；门跑没跑、过没过，有据可查。
- **不假封闭**：用户模式下**写入真的被拒**（有夹具证明目标文件未变）；开发者模式需用户**原话**解锁。
- **不造第二套说法**：`--selftest` 与 `audit` 会把"文档覆盖、规则表重复、真源单一所有者、门元数据、工具自检、数字漂移"六项**自动核**一遍。

## 目录

```
bin/                 CLI 编排层（studio.cjs 及各子工具，全部自带 --selftest）
references/          真源：pipeline.json（门/阶段/契约）· templates.json（章节骨架与预算）
                     market-parity.md（市面对齐取证与缺口）· plugin-spec-v3.md（V3 规格）
                     audit-2026-10-14.md（出厂审查报告）· aris-read-report.md（已读/未读如实报告）
plugin/              DSH 插件 V3（免编译 ESM）：dist/plugin.js · skill/SKILL.md · hub/ · selftest.mjs
docs/                快速上手
SKILL.md             技能说明（触发语 · 子命令用法 · 红线）
```

## 快速开始（CLI）

```bat
node bin\studio.cjs route "给这篇稿子做投稿前体检"     :: 判任务类型 + 链路 + 必过门
node bin\studio.cjs sections --genre research          :: 章节骨架（含篇幅预算与"必答问题"）
node bin\studio.cjs audit                              :: 出厂审查（完整性/重复性/数字一致性 6 项）
node bin\studio.cjs selftest                           :: 编排层自检
```

## 安装为 DSH 插件

```bat
:: 作为 bundle 装进 DSH profile（本地路径安装用 link: 规格）
plugin_manager install_bundle target="link:<本仓路径>/plugin"
```

装完宿主会注册两个工具：

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| **`paper_studio`** | 唯一使用入口。`action=modes` 取五模式菜单（用宿主的可点击选项呈现）· `action=intent` **确定性判意图**（该启/不该启/拿不准）· 其余 action 桥接 CLI 并返回**退出码** |
| **`paper_dev`** | 开发者模式：`list/read/write/unlock/seal`。**用户模式默认封闭**，`write` 被拒并给解锁指引；写入仅限白名单资产根，越界拒收 |

**环境变量**：`DSH_PAPER_STUDIO_ROOT`（指向本仓根，未设时按 `~/.agents/skills/paper-studio` → `~/.dsh/skills/paper-studio` → `~/paper-studio` → `/opt/paper-studio` 顺序找）· `DSH_PAPER_HUB`（状态目录，默认 `~/.dsh/paper-studio`）。

## 自检（改完必跑）

```bat
node plugin\selftest.mjs         :: 20 项：注册形态 · 严格 JSON Schema · 真封闭 · 越界拒收 · 五模式差异化 · 意图夹具 · 端到端跑 CLI
node bin\studio.cjs audit        :: 6 项：文档覆盖 · 规则表重复 · 真源单一所有者 · 门元数据 · 工具自检实跑 · 数字漂移
node bin\studio.cjs selftest     :: 编排层 53 项
```

## 依赖与边界

- **运行时**：Node.js ≥ 20。联网/检索能力由宿主或你的其它技能提供，本仓**不要求任何付费或需登录的 API**。
- **本机路径登记**：`references/pipeline.json` 的 `assets` 段登记了**作者本机的资产路径**（论文方法本体仓、Python 解释器等）。换机器时按你的布局改这几项，或用环境变量覆盖。
- **明确不做**：不生成图片（图表只给题注文本/绘图建议/Mermaid 源码）· 不做规避 AI 检测类操作。
- **许可**：见 `LICENSE`（MIT）与 `NOTICE.md`（**三分类口径**：机制/思想不受著作权保护 · 本方实现 MIT · 本仓不含逐字复印的上游正文）。

## 两端同步说明（**如实记录**）

- **主仓：Gitee** —— <https://gitee.com/Suzumiya-haruhi16/dsh-paper-studio>
- **GitHub 侧** —— <https://github.com/liuhaolong16/dsh-paper-studio>（**公开可读**）

> **当前状态（2026-10-14 复核）**：**两端均已公开可读**，三端 commit 一致。
> 可见性判据：`git -c credential.helper= clone <url>` **且**配一个已知公开仓做对照（只用"clone 成功"判公开会被 git 凭据助手污染）；另用匿名 API 复核（GitHub `api.github.com` / Gitee `api/v5` 均 200）。

作者所在网络**无法直连 `github.com` 的 git over HTTPS**（实测：`curl https://github.com/...` 超时；但 `https://api.github.com` 200 正常）。因此 GitHub 侧的同步采用**由 GitHub 自己拉取**的方式，而不是本机推上去：

1. **一次性引导**：在 GitHub 网页用 **Import a repository** 指向上面 Gitee 主仓地址 —— GitHub 服务端会连 Gitee 克隆整个仓（含历史），本机网络不参与。
2. **此后的自动同步**：本仓自带 `.github/workflows/sync-from-gitee.yml`，会**每 6 小时**（以及手动 dispatch 时）由 Actions 运行器把 Gitee 的 `main` 镜像过来 —— **无需任何额外凭据**（用运行器自带的 `GITHUB_TOKEN`）。

> 为什么不用"本机直推"：本机没有可用代理 / `gh` / SSH 密钥，且逐文件走 API 需把 530 KB 内容经模型上下文传输（约十几万 token）——**代价不可接受**，故不采用。

## 相关仓

- 论文方法本体（11 维判据 · 机器门 · 投稿前检查表）：`research-paper-playbook`

plugins.description: 应急证据包：查出了事能不能拿出证据（预案/联系人/日志保全/上报流程）。
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-incident-package

**应急证据包** —— 查出了事能不能拿出证据：预案、联系人、日志保全、上报流程。

## 不装它会怎样

你的项目有日志：

```js
const logger = require('winston');
logger.info('app started');
```

**看起来该有的都有了。但出事那天你会发现：**

```
① 预案呢？          —— 《网络安全法》第 25 条：应当制定
② 打给谁？          —— 凌晨三点没人知道该找谁
③ 日志能证明什么？   —— 日志和业务库同机同账号，攻击者进来一把删掉
④ 要报给主管部门吗？ —— 数据安全法第 29 条：还要及时告知用户
```

**平时不备，事到临头就晚了。** 而这些都是**可以提前自查**的。

## 关键词
**关键词**：应急预案 · 应急响应 · 应急联系人 · 证据保全 · 事件上报 · 日志留存 · 网络安全法 · 数据安全法
**Keywords**: incident response · emergency plan · evidence preservation · incident reporting · CSL · DSL

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 找不到**应急预案** | 网安法 25 条 |
| 🔴 高 | 有日志但找不到**证据保全**（异地/不可篡改/快照）| 网安法 21 条 · 等保 安全审计 |
| 🟡 中 | 找不到**应急联系人** | 等保 安全管理体系 |
| 🟡 中 | 找不到**事件上报流程** | 网安法 25 条 · 数据安全法 29 条 |

## 「日志被一把删掉」是这个插件重点要拦的

很多团队有日志，但**日志和业务库在同一台机器、同一个账号下**。

攻击者进来第一件事就是删日志 —— 事后什么都查不到。

等保要求「审计记录应受到保护，**避免受到未预期的删除、修改或覆盖**」。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-incident-package
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-incident-package
```

![dsh-incident-package 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-incident-package/report.png)

![dsh-incident-package 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-incident-package/demo.png)

![dsh-incident-package 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-incident-package/rules.png)

## 用法

```bash
dsh-incident-package --demo
dsh-incident-package --list-rules
dsh-incident-package --html r.html
```

## 边界

- **不检查预案质量** —— 只查「有没有」。预案写得好不好、演练过没有，需要人工评审。
- **不验证联系人真的能打通** —— 只查文档里有没有。
- **预案可能在其他仓库/内部系统** —— 报出来是提示你确认，不是断定你没做。
- **证据保全只看配置与文档** —— 实际存储权限、WORM 策略是否生效，需要人工验证。
- 与 [dsh-alert-relay](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-alert-relay) 分工：
  那个查**出事时通知谁**，这个查**出事前准备了什么**。
- 与 [dsh-cn-log-retention](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) 分工：
  那个查日志**留多久**，这个查日志**能不能被信任**。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**


---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 22 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope)

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: inject a body-level extra_headers entry into OpenAI-compatible chat/completions requests for listed providers and upstream hosts (the only injection point that survives a LiteLLM relay).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-litellm-extra-headers

给 DeepSeek Harness 用的宿主插件：把 `extra_headers: { "<header>": "<value>" }` 塞进 **OpenAI 兼容请求的 body**，只对「配置里列出的 provider 路由」+「配置里列出的上游 host」生效。

用途：绕过 LiteLLM 之类的反向代理丢弃客户端 HTTP 头的问题——某些上游（例如 OpenCode / 网关自建的会话亲和）要求每个请求带 `x-opencode-session`，而代理只在 `body.extra_headers` 里认这个字段。

简体中文 | [English summary](#english-summary)

## 为什么只能这么做（已核实，改动前先读）

1. **客户端 HTTP 头在 LiteLLM 这一跳被丢弃。** 实测把 `x-opencode-session` 加在请求头上，上游仍然 500；改放 `body.extra_headers` 后 200。
2. **DSH 的 `llm-pi-ai` 适配器只白名单转发** `temperature` / `maxTokens` / `sessionId` / `signal` / `headers` / … 这些字段（见其 `profileOptions()`），pi-ai 唯一能塞任意 body 字段的入口 `options.samplingParams` 在 DSH 里没有暴露，所以纯配置解决不了。
3. **现成的 `dsh-opencode-session` 插件是「加 HTTP 头」的**，在这条链路上注定无效；而且它的默认 `providers` 是 pi-ai 目录里的 `['opencode', 'opencode-go']`，不含自定义路由键（如 `gwds`、`go`）。
4. **pi-ai 的 `openai-completions` 走官方 `openai` SDK**（v6.40.0），SDK 通过 `this.fetch = options.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch` 调用 `globalThis.fetch`。因此运行时替换 `globalThis.fetch` 是当前唯一可用的宿主侧注入点。

结论：**不要在别处再加 header**，那条路已经验证过是死的；要新字段就往 body 里合。

## 安装

已发布在 npm：`dsh-litellm-extra-headers@0.1.0`

```sh
# npm（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-litellm-extra-headers

# 从本地目录（开发时推荐，link 安装，改动即时生效）
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-litellm-extra-headers
# 从打包产物
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-litellm-extra-headers-0.1.0.tgz
# 从 git 主机（本包是纯 JS，无需 pnpm 放行构建脚本）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:chenyifawan-cell/dsh-litellm-extra-headers
```

包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 会插入一行插件；`dsh plugin add` 识别到 `dsh.bundle` 后自动把本包加进该 profile 的 `bundles` 列表。装完确认一层存在：

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config | Select-String litellm-extra-headers
```

不想装包也可以手工把这一行写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（行指向本包名或 `index.js` 路径）。包内自带的这一行 `providers` / `hosts` **默认留空**（空列表 = 插件保持惰性），把你的路由键和上游地址填进去才生效：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: litellm-extra-headers
      name: dsh-litellm-extra-headers
      config:
        providers: [gwds, go]                # 你的路由键
        hosts: ["litellm.internal:4000"]     # 只有这些上游才注入
        header: x-opencode-session
        mode: session-id
        value: null
        debug: false
        debugFile: null
```

## 配置字段

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `providers` | `string[]` | `[]` | `llm/stream` 的 `options.provider` 路由键白名单。**必须显式列出**，匹配大小写不敏感。 |
| `hosts` | `string[]` | `[]` | 允许注入的上游 `host[:port]` 白名单；带 scheme / path 的写法会被归一化（`http://litellm.internal:4000/v1` → `litellm.internal:4000`）。**必须显式列出**。 |
| `header` | `string` | `x-opencode-session` | 放进 `extra_headers` 的字段名。 |
| `mode` | `session-id` \| `uuid` \| `fixed` | `session-id` | 取值来源：DSH 会话 id（跨轮次、跨重启稳定）／每会话一个进程内随机 uuid／配置里的字面量。 |
| `value` | `string` | — | `mode: fixed` 时的字面量；`fixed` 却没给值会在加载时报错。 |
| `debug` | `boolean` | `false` | 每次注入决策打一条 `ctx.logger.info`。 |
| `debugFile` | `string` | — | 每次注入决策追加一行 JSON（含 provider / model / session / host / path / event / reason），进程控制台看不到时用它排错。 |

`providers` 或 `hosts` 为空时插件**保持惰性**并打一条 warning：一个可以共享出去的包，不应该对别人没被告知过的网关偷偷加字段。

## 设计要点

1. **双层匹配，缺一不可。**
   - `llm/stream` waterfall 里判断 `options.provider ∈ providers` 且存在 `options.sessionId`，才把 `{ value, provider, model, session }` 放进 `AsyncLocalStorage`（这一步才有路由键）。
   - `fetch` patch 里再判断目标 URL 的 `host ∈ hosts` 才改 body。
   - 于是别人路由键跟你不同时，只会改白名单里的网关，不会给别人的网关塞未知字段。
2. **只改 `/chat/completions` 的 JSON body。** 条件是 `method === 'POST'` + `content-type` 含 `application/json` + `typeof init.body === 'string'` + `pathname` 以 `/chat/completions` 结尾。解析失败一律原样放行；`extra_headers` 已存在时**合并而不覆盖**，已有同名字段时尊重调用方、不覆盖。
3. **零依赖 + 可还原。** 只用 `node:async_hooks` / `node:crypto` / `node:fs/promises`；安装与卸载都是 `ctx.effect()`，dispose 时 `globalThis.fetch` 按引用还原（被别人又包了一层也不会误还原）。

## 验证

```sh
npm test          # node --test：条目命中 / 非命中 / 已存在不覆盖 / 非 JSON 原样 / dispose 还原（19 项）
npm run test:e2e  # 真机链路：本地 mock 上游 + 真实 dsh headless 跑一轮，对照组不带插件
```

按顺序，前一步不过不进下一步：

1. `npm test` 全绿。
2. `npm run test:e2e`：起一个会记录请求体的本地 OpenAI 兼容上游，用 `dsh --profile headless --patch` 把 provider 指向它并挂上本插件，跑一轮真实会话。断言：命中的请求 body 里多出 `extra_headers`、值在整轮里稳定（同一个会话 id）、**对照组（去掉插件行）没有这个字段**，并且 `debugFile` 有 `event: "inject"` 记录。
3. **换到能连到 LiteLLM 的那台机器上**（第 2 步用的是本地 mock 上游，不需要网络）再跑一轮，用 `debugFile` 确认日志里出现注入记录，且上游不再报缺少会话头。这一步验证的是 LiteLLM 自己的「body.extra_headers → 上游请求头」合并行为，只有真实网关能证明。
   对照实验：手动 `curl` 只带 HTTP 头、不带 `extra_headers` → 上游报错；body 里带 `extra_headers` → 通过。

## 发布备忘（首次发布踩过的坑）

1. **2FA 必须开**：npm 只支持安全密钥（Windows Hello 指纹/PIN 或 YubiKey），没有 Google Authenticator 那种 TOTP。
2. **`npm publish` 要在真终端里跑**：npm 只在 stdin/stdout 都是 TTY 时才走「自动开浏览器 → 轮询授权 → 自动重试上传」那条路（`lib/utils/auth.js` 的 `otplease`）；管道化的非交互进程会直接抛 EOTP，而错误文本里的授权 URL 被 `@npmcli/redact` 打码，等于拿不到链接。
3. **新包名会先进审核**：首次发布会先在 registry 上生成一个 `0.0.0-stage` 占位版本（"Temporary package placeholder for staged publishing"），真正的版本进入审核，CLI 只提示 `Your package is being processed`。几分钟后正式版本自动上线，`latest` 指向它，占位版留在历史里。期间 `npm stage list` 可能为空，不用慌。
4. 发布前记得 `--registry=https://registry.npmjs.org`：本机若把 registry 指向 npmmirror 这类只读镜像，默认 `npm publish` 会打错源。

## 已知边界

- `input` 是 `Request` 对象时（body 在 Request 里，同步读不出来）不改，原样放行；当前 pi-ai + openai SDK 走的是「URL 字符串 + init.body 字符串」，不触发这条。
- `extra_headers` 存在但不是普通对象（数组 / 字符串等）时原样放行，避免把别人的 body 改坏。
- 只注入，不做重试、不改 header、不改其它 body 字段。

## English summary

Host plugin for DeepSeek Harness: while a model call routed to a configured provider streams, `globalThis.fetch` merges `extra_headers[<header>] = <value>` into the JSON body of `POST .../chat/completions` requests sent to a configured upstream host. It exists because a LiteLLM relay drops client HTTP headers (verified: header-only 500, body `extra_headers` 200), DSH's pi-ai adapter whitelists request fields, and the existing `dsh-opencode-session` plugin only sets a header. Both `providers` and `hosts` must be listed explicitly, or the plugin stays inert. MIT.

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-quberi

Search and save to your [Quberi](https://ai.quberi.com) knowledge base from
DeepSeek Harness.

Ask Harness a question about your documents. The first time, your browser
opens by itself so you can approve access; after that the model can call
`quberi_search`, which finds passages in the documents **you** can read in
Quberi, in the one organization you pick. It can also call `quberi_save` to add
a note (a conclusion, decision or summary from the chat) to your knowledge base.
Saving is new in 0.3.0 and needs a fresh approval that includes **save**.

## Install

In DeepSeek Harness open **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter:

```
dsh-quberi
```

Or from a terminal (replace `desktop` with your profile name):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-quberi
```

Then restart Harness. To upgrade, remove the old version first
(`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-quberi`), then add it again.

You need a Quberi account at [ai.quberi.com](https://ai.quberi.com), or your own
Quberi server (see Configuration).

A plugin runs on your machine with your permissions, so read the source first.
It is small: `src/oauth.ts` (sign-in helpers), `src/browser.ts` (opens your
browser), `src/controller.ts` (sign-in, token refresh, search, save) and
`src/index.ts` (the `/quberi` command and the tool). Its only runtime
dependency is `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`.

### From source

```sh
npm install
npm test
npm pack      # builds lib/ and writes dsh-quberi-<version>.tgz
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-quberi-<version>.tgz
```

## Use

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/quberi login` | Opens your browser to sign in to Quberi (the link is also shown in case it does not open). Choose an organization and allow. You rarely need this: the first search does it for you. If you signed in with an older version (read only), run it again to allow saving. |
| `/quberi status` | Shows whether you are connected. Never prints a token. |
| `/quberi logout` | Revokes the sign-in at Quberi and forgets it locally. |

You can also disconnect any time in Quberi under **Account → Connected tools**.

When sign-in finishes, the browser shows a confirmation page and Harness is
brought back to the front (macOS). Nothing needs to be copied or pasted.

On a machine with no screen (a remote shell), the browser is not opened; the
plugin gives you the link to open on another device instead.

## Before it works

The organization you choose must allow outside tools. It is **off by default**.
An owner or admin turns it on under **Admin console → Integrations → Outside
tools**; owners and admins also get a "Turn on" button on the approval page.

## What leaves Quberi

The passages the search returns go to Harness and to whichever AI model Harness
uses. Quberi's "check before sending" step does not apply to this path. Every
search is recorded in the organization's audit log (the tool's name and the
documents returned, never the question or the text).

## Saving notes

`quberi_save` takes a title, the note text (Markdown) and, optionally, the name
of a space. With no space it saves into **your personal space**. The tool asks
the model to offer to save and wait for you to agree, not to save silently, but
that is an instruction to the model, not a guarantee: you decide by what you
approve and by watching what the model does.

A saved note becomes a document in that space. **Anyone who can read that space
can find it**, so name a shared space only on purpose. Saving is recorded in
the audit log (the tool's name and the new document, not the text).

## What it can and cannot do

- It acts as you: search only reads spaces you can read, and save only writes
  into spaces you can edit. Both are re-checked on every call. If your access
  changes, the next call reflects it.
- It can add notes, nothing else. It cannot edit or delete anything that is
  already there, and it cannot upload files.
- Saving is a separate permission (`knowledge:write`). A sign-in made by an
  earlier version only allows search; it is not upgraded behind your back.
- Access tokens last one hour and refresh on their own; a sign-in lasts at most
  90 days. A refresh token that is used twice is treated as stolen and the whole
  sign-in is revoked.
- Turning outside tools off for the organization, or disconnecting in Quberi,
  stops the very next search or save.

## Configuration

Defaults are right for the hosted service. For a self-hosted Quberi, point
`baseUrl` at your API (https, or `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` for development).
`openBrowser`, `autoLogin` and `focusApp` (all on by default) switch off the
automatic browser, sign-in on first use, and returning to Harness:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: quberi
      name: dsh-quberi
      config:
        baseUrl: https://api.example.com
        # openBrowser: false
        # autoLogin: false
        # focusApp: false
```

## Compatibility

Built and tested against `@deepseek-ai/*` `0.2.0-rc.2`. Harness is a developer
preview and its plugin interfaces can change. The token set is stored with the
credential-record API (`credentials.modifyRecord`) so two Harness processes
cannot overwrite each other's rotated refresh token.

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

plugins.description: Delete a DSH session together with the workspace artifacts that session produced - the file list is reconstructed from the session log and previewed with its total size. The artifacts can also be deleted on their own, keeping the conversation.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-artifacts

**This package is built by DeepSeek-v4.1 flash!**

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-session-artifacts.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-artifacts)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

**English** · [中文](README-zh.md)

**Clean up what a session left in your workspace** — and, when you want it,
delete the session record too. Opt-in, previewed, and verified before anything
is removed.

A session's scripts, reports and generated files stay behind after the
conversation is gone. Nothing in DSH records which files those were, so this
plugin reconstructs that from the session log and shows you the exact list —
with the total size — before anything is deleted.

Three things it can do, chosen by two checkboxes in one dialog:

- **Delete the artifacts, keep the conversation** — tidy up a session's mess
  without losing the session.
- **Delete the session record** — with or without its artifacts.
- **Neither is assumed**: the artifact step is off by default.

It is **self-contained**: it removes the session record itself and does not call
`dsh-chat-manager`'s `/plugins/dsh-session-delete` route, so it keeps working
when that plugin is disabled or absent.

## What it does

1. Open the session's **⋯** menu and pick **Delete session and artifacts…**
2. The dialog shows the exact file list and total size **before** you commit.
3. Tick what you want removed. At least one box must be ticked.
4. Confirm. When the record is being removed it goes first, then the previewed
   files.
5. If a file could not be removed, the dialog offers **Retry the files left
   behind** — it retries exactly those paths, not the whole preview.

The artifacts-only mode needs no session deletion at all: the Host holds the
previewed list behind a nonce, so the files are removable while the session and
its log stay exactly where they are.

## Deleting the session record

The persistence seam deliberately has **no deletion API** — its own contract
states that logs accumulate under the session root until removed externally. So
this plugin performs the removal itself, against the fixed layout:

```
<sessionRoot>/<project>/<sessionId>/session[.vN].jsonl[.zstd]
```

The location is resolved through the persistence backend
(`resolveCurrentLog`), then every component is re-checked before anything is
touched:

- exactly three segments under the root, with a session-log leaf name;
- each directory is a real directory and the log a real file — no symlinks;
- nothing resolves outside the root;
- removal is a **two-step quarantine**: the directory is renamed into a sibling
  temp directory, its identity is re-verified there, and only then deleted. A
  failure part-way restores the original rather than leaving it half-deleted.

### Stopping a session that is open

An open session is **live in the host registries** even when nothing is running
in it, so its log writer is still attached and its row would reappear in the
sidebar. It has to be torn down before its storage can go — and the registry
exposes no `dispose`.

The only supported teardown is the `AgentHandle` returned to whoever *created*
the Agent, so this plugin keeps its **own handle tracker**: it observes Agent
creation on the shared `agents` service and retains each handle. Deletion then:

1. cancels a running turn (the same path the Stop button uses);
2. disposes the Agent through its handle — this is what unregisters it and
   detaches its Session;
3. waits for both registries to drain, then removes the storage.

The tracker is this plugin's own rather than another plugin's, so the capability
does not go away when that plugin does.

**One case cannot be handled:** an Agent that was already live *before* the
plugin loaded has no captured handle (the handle was only ever given to its
creator). That deletion is refused with a message telling you to restart DSH —
after a restart the plugin sees every Agent from the start. It is refused rather
than deleted underneath its writer, because reporting a deletion that did not
happen is worse than not deleting.

## How a file is attributed to a session

The durable session log is the only authoritative record of what a session
touched, so attribution is read from it:

| Evidence | Meaning | Deletable |
|---|---|---|
| `write` result with `meta.operation: "create"` | the session materialized the file | yes |
| shell command window + file creation time | the file was created while a command ran | yes, if unique |
| `present` call | the session delivered the file | **no** (reported only) |
| `write` result with `meta.operation: "update"` | the session rewrote a file that already existed | **no** |
| `edit` call | the session only rewrote an existing file | **no** |

Rewriting a file you already owned never makes it disposable, so `update` and
`edit` results are reported but never offered. A failed tool call
(`FS_SANDBOX_DENIED`, `FS_NOT_OBSERVED`, `FS_STALE_VERSION`, …) contributes
nothing, because the tool never materialized anything.

`present` is **delivery, not authorship**: a session asked to hand you a paper
you already had would otherwise make that paper deletable. Delivered-only files
are counted in the dialog and left alone. Set `includeDelivered: true` to opt
into the older, more aggressive behavior.

### Shell-created files

File-tool writes are recorded explicitly. Shell commands are not: a `pwsh` call
records only its command text, and its `tool/result` carries no `meta` at all,
so nothing durable names the files a `python foo.py` run produced. In practice
this is the *dominant* source of leftovers — a session that writes twenty
scripts through the shell produces twenty artifacts that a file-tool-only
reader never sees.

The remaining evidence is **creation time**. On NTFS `birthtime` is a real
creation timestamp, distinct from `mtime`, and it survives later edits — so it
answers "was this file created while this command was running?". Pairing each
shell `tool/call` with its `tool/result` gives a tight window per command.

Three rules keep this safe:

- **Tight windows.** Only the interval a command actually ran counts. A
  whole-session window is unusable: a session that ran two commands and then
  spent twenty minutes browsing would otherwise claim every file created during
  its lifetime. (Measured on a real log: such a session had 90 files inside its
  session-wide span and **0** inside its actual command windows.)
- **Uniqueness.** A file created inside two sessions' windows is attributed to
  neither, because a wrong attribution deletes something this session never
  made. Concurrent sessions therefore reduce the result instead of corrupting
  it.
- **Fail closed.** If the sibling sessions cannot be enumerated, the pass
  claims nothing and says so in the dialog. "Only my window covers it" cannot
  be established without knowing the others.

Only creation is claimed. A file that merely *changed* during a window was not
produced by the session and is left alone. Inferred files are labelled
`命令行` / `shell` in the list, since they rest on weaker evidence than a
recorded write.

## Safety

- **Workspace fence.** A session may only ever propose files inside its own
  recorded working directory.
- **DSH home fence.** Nothing under `~/.dsh` is ever an artifact, *whatever the
  session's working directory is*. The workspace fence alone is relative to
  `cwd`, so a session opened at `~` or `C:\` could otherwise reach the
  installed plugins, the built skills, the profiles, and the credential store.
  A genuine workspace nested inside the home (e.g. `~/.dsh/scratch`) still owns
  its own files, but cannot reach its neighbours.
- **Package fence.** A file inside a directory that is a DSH package — it holds
  `SKILL.md`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `cordis.yml`, or a `package.json` with a
  `dsh`/`cordis` block — is not offered, so a plugin or skill the session built
  inside its own workspace survives. Set `protectPackages: false` to disable.
- **Symlinks.** A candidate whose real path escapes the workspace through a
  symlink is skipped, both at preview and at removal time.
